subjMeta(course.subject)\n  const modules = buildModules(course)\n  const reviews = buildReviews(course)\n  const st = cStatusMeta(course.status)\n  const hours = Math.max(1, Math.round((course.lessons * 16) / 60))\n  const TABS = [\n    { id: 'info',    label: 'Thông tin', icon: 'info' },\n    { id: 'content', label: 'Nội dung',  icon: 'list_alt' },\n    { id: 'stats',   label: 'Thống kê',  icon: 'insights' },\n    { id: 'reviews', label: 'Đánh giá',  icon: 'reviews' },\n  ]\n  const Detail = ({ label, value }) => (\n    <div>\n      <p className=\"text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wide\">{label}</p>\n      <p className=\"text-sm text-on-surface font-medium mt-0.5\">{value}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n  return (\n    <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-[70] ${show ? '' : 'pointer-events-none'}`}>\n      <div className={`absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 transition-opacity duration-300 ${show ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`} onClick={onClose} />\n      <aside className={`absolute top-0 right-0 h-full w-full max-w-[540px] bg-surface shadow-2xl flex flex-col transform transition-transform duration-300 ${show ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'}`}>\n        {/* Header */}\n        <div className=\"p-6 bg-white border-b border-outline-variant\">\n          <div className=\"flex justify-between items-start mb-4\">\n            <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 ${st.badge}`}>\n              <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]\">{st.icon}</span>{course.status}\n            </span>\n            <button onClick={onClose} className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors\">\n              <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined\">close</span>\n            </button>\n          </div>\n          <CourseThumb course={course} size=\"lg\" />\n          <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-on-background mt-4 leading-snug\">{course.title}</h2>\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mt-2 text-sm text-on-surface-variant\">\n            <span className=\"font-mono text-xs\">#{course.id}</span>\n            <span className=\"w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-outline-variant\" />\n            <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold ${m.tag}`}>{course.subject}</span>\n            <span className=\"w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-outline-variant\" />\n            <span className=\"font-semibold text-on-surface\">{fmtVND(course.price)}</span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        {/* Tabs */}\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 px-6 bg-white border-b border-outline-variant\">\n          {TABS.map(t => (\n            <button key={t.id} onClick={() => onTab(t.id)}\n              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-3 text-sm font-semibold border-b-2 -mb-px transition-colors ${tab === t.id ? 'border-primary text-primary' : 'border-transparent text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface'}`}>\n              <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]\">{t.icon}</span>{t.label}\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n        {/* Body */}\n        <div className=\"flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6\">\n          {tab === 'info' && (\n            <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n              <div>\n                <h4 className=\"text-sm font-bold text-on-background mb-2\">Mô tả khóa học</h4>\n                <p className=\"text-sm text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed\">{course.desc}</p>\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-white border border-outline-variant\">\n                <Detail label=\"Gia sư\" value={course.tutor} />\n                <Detail label=\"Môn học\" value={course.subject} />\n                <Detail label=\"Giá bán\" value={fmtVND(course.price)} />\n                <Detail label=\"Số bài học\" value={`${course.lessons} bài`} />\n                <Detail label=\"Ngày tạo\" value={fmtDMY(course.created)} />\n                <Detail label=\"Cập nhật\" value={fmtDMY(course.updated)} />\n                <Detail label=\"Học viên\" value={fmtInt(course.students)} />\n                <Detail label=\"Đánh giá\" value={course.rating ? `⭐ ${course.rating} (${course.reviews})` : 'Chưa có'} />\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          )}\n          {tab === 'content' && (\n            <div className=\"space-y-4\">\n              {modules.map((mod, i) => (\n                <div key={i} className=\"bg-white rounded-xl border border-outline-variant overflow-hidden\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 border-b border-outline-variant\">\n                    <p className=\"text-sm font-bold text-on-surface\">{mod.title}</p>\n                    <span className=\"text-xs text-on-surface-variant\">{mod.items.length} mục</span>\n                  </div>\n                  <ul className=\"divide-y divide-outline-variant\">\n                    {mod.items.map((it, j) => (\n                      <li key={j} className=\"flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5\">\n                        <span className={`material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] ${it.type === 'quiz' ? 'text-violet-600' : 'text-primary'}`}>\n                          {it.type === 'quiz' ? 'quiz' : 'play_circle'}\n                        </span>\n                        <span className=\"text-sm text-on-surface flex-1 truncate\">{it.title}</span>\n                        <span className=\"text-xs text-on-surface-variant shrink-0\">{it.type === 'quiz' ? `${it.q} câu` : it.duration}</span>\n                      </li>\n                    ))}\n                  </ul>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n          {tab === 'stats' && (\n            <div className=\"space-y-4\">\n              <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-3\">\n                {[\n                  { label: 'Tổng học viên', value: fmtInt(course.students), icon: 'group', color: 'text-blue-600 bg-blue-50' },\n                  { label: 'Tỷ lệ hoàn thành', value: `${course.completion}%`, icon: 'task_alt', color: 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50' },\n                  { label: 'Doanh thu', value: fmtCompactVND(course.revenue), icon: 'payments', color: 'text-violet-600 bg-violet-50' },\n                  { label: 'Thời lượng', value: `${hours} giờ`, icon: 'schedule', color: 'text-amber-600 bg-amber-50' },\n                ].map((s, i) => (\n                  <div key={i} className=\"bg-white rounded-xl border border-outline-variant p-4\">\n                    <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center ${s.color} mb-3`}>\n                      <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]\">{s.icon}</span>\n                    </div>\n                    <p className=\"text-xl font-bold text-on-background\">{s.value}</p>\n                    <p className=\"text-xs text-on-surface-variant mt-0.5\">{s.label}</p>\n                  </div>\n                ))}\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl border border-outline-variant p-4\">\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-3\">\n                  <p className=\"text-sm font-bold text-on-surface\">Đánh giá trung bình</p>\n                  <p className=\"text-sm font-bold text-amber-500\">⭐ {course.rating || '—'}</p>\n                </div>\n                <div className=\"w-full bg-gray-100 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden\">\n                  <div className=\"bg-amber-400 h-full rounded-full\" style={{ width: `${(course.rating / 5) * 100}%` }} />\n                </div>\n                <p className=\"text-xs text-on-surface-variant mt-2\">Dựa trên {fmtInt(course.reviews)} lượt đánh giá</p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          )}\n          {tab === 'reviews' && (\n            <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n              {reviews.length === 0 && (\n                <div className=\"text-center py-12 text-on-surface-variant\">\n                  <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[48px] text-gray-300\">reviews</span>\n                  <p className=\"text-sm mt-2\">Khóa học chưa có đánh giá nào.</p>\n                </div>\n              )}\n              {reviews.map((r, i) => (\n                <div key={i} className=\"bg-white rounded-xl border border-outline-variant p-4\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-2\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                      <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full ${AVATAR_COLORS[i % AVATAR_COLORS.length]} flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs font-bold`}>{initialsOf(r.name)}</div>\n                      <div>\n                        <p className=\"text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface\">{r.name}</p>\n                        <p className=\"text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant\">{r.date}</p>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                    <span className=\"text-amber-500 text-sm font-bold\">{'★'.repeat(r.score)}<span className=\"text-gray-300\">{'★'.repeat(5 - r.score)}</span></span>\n                  </div>\n                  <p className=\"text-sm text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed\">{r.comment}</p>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      </aside>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction CourseManagementView() {\n  const [courses, setCourses]         = useState(MOCK_COURSES)\n  const [loading, setLoading]         = useState(true)\n  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('Tất cả')\n  const [search, setSearch]           = useState('')\n  const [sort, setSort]               = useState({ key: 'updated', dir: 'desc' })\n  const [selected, setSelected]       = useState(() => new Set())\n  const [page, setPage]               = useState(1)\n  const pageSize = 6\n  const [drawer, setDrawer]           = useState(null)\n  const [drawerShow, setDrawerShow]   = useState(false)\n  const [drawerTab, setDrawerTab]     = useState('info')\n  const [menu, setMenu]               = useState(null)   // { id, x, y }\n  const [confirm, setConfirm]         = useState(null)   // { title, message, danger, confirmLabel, onConfirm }\n  const [toast, setToast]             = useState(null)\n\n  useEffect(() => { const t = setTimeout(() => setLoading(false), 650); return () => clearTimeout(t) }, [])\n  useEffect(() => { if (!toast) return; const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2600); return () => clearTimeout(t) }, [toast])\n  useEffect(() => { setPage(1) }, [statusFilter, search])\n\n  const showToast = (msg, type = 'success') => setToast({ msg, type })\n\n  // ── Derived rows ──\n  const chip = C_CHIPS.find(c => c.key === statusFilter)\n  const filtered = courses.filter(c => {\n    if (chip && chip.match && !chip.match(c)) return false\n    if (search.trim()) {\n      const q = search.toLowerCase()\n      if (!(c.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || c.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) || c.tutor.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return false\n    }\n    return true\n  })\n  const sorted = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {\n    const dir = sort.dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1\n    let av = a[sort.key], bv = b[sort.key]\n    if (sort.key === 'updated' || sort.key === 'created') { av = new Date(av).getTime(); bv = new Date(bv).getTime() }\n    if (sort.key === 'title' || sort.key === 'tutor' || sort.key === 'subject') { av = String(av).toLowerCase(); bv = String(bv).toLowerCase() }\n    return av < bv ? -dir : av > bv ? dir : 0\n  })\n  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(sorted.length / pageSize))\n  const safePage = Math.min(page, totalPages)\n  const pageRows = sorted.slice((safePage - 1) * pageSize, safePage * pageSize)\n\n  const toggleSort = key => setSort(s => s.key === key ? { key, dir: s.dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc' } : { key, dir: 'desc' })\n  const pageIds = pageRows.map(c => c.id)\n  const allPageSelected = pageIds.length > 0 && pageIds.every(id => selected.has(id))\n  const somePageSelected = pageIds.some(id => selected.has(id))\n  const togglePageAll = () => setSelected(prev => {\n    const next = new Set(prev)\n    if (allPageSelected) pageIds.forEach(id => next.delete(id))\n    else pageIds.forEach(id => next.add(id))\n    return next\n  })\n  const toggleOne = id => setSelected(prev => { const n = new Set(prev); n.has(id) ? n.delete(id) : n.add(id); return n })\n  const clearSelection = () => setSelected(new Set())\n\n  // ── Mutations ──\n  const setStatus = (ids, status, msg) => {\n    setCourses(prev => prev.map(c => ids.includes(c.id) ? { ...c, status, updated: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) } : c))\n    showToast(msg)\n  }\n  const removeCourses = (ids, msg) => { setCourses(prev => prev.filter(c => !ids.includes(c.id))); showToast(msg) }\n\n  const askConfirm = cfg => setConfirm(cfg)\n  const idsLabel = ids => ids.length === 1 ? `khóa học #${ids[0]}` : `${ids.length} khóa học`\n\n  const doApprove  = ids => { setStatus(ids, 'Hoạt động', `Đã duyệt ${idsLabel(ids)}.`); clearSelection() }\n  const doReject   = ids => askConfirm({ title: 'Từ chối khóa học', message: `Bạn chắc chắn muốn từ chối ${idsLabel(ids)}? Khóa học sẽ chuyển về trạng thái bản nháp.`, confirmLabel: 'Từ chối', danger: true, onConfirm: () => { setStatus(ids, 'Bản nháp', `Đã từ chối ${idsLabel(ids)}.`); clearSelection() } })\n  const doArchive  = ids => askConfirm({ title: 'Lưu trữ khóa học', message: `Lưu trữ ${idsLabel(ids)}? Khóa học sẽ ẩn khỏi trang chủ nhưng dữ liệu được giữ lại.`, confirmLabel: 'Lưu trữ', danger: false, onConfirm: () => { setStatus(ids, 'Đã lưu trữ', `Đã lưu trữ ${idsLabel(ids)}.`); clearSelection() } })\n  const doHide     = ids => askConfirm({ title: 'Ẩn khóa học', message: `Ẩn ${idsLabel(ids)} khỏi kết quả tìm kiếm công khai?`, confirmLabel: 'Ẩn', danger: false, onConfirm: () => { showToast(`Đã ẩn ${idsLabel(ids)}.`); clearSelection() } })\n  const doDelete   = ids => askConfirm({ title: 'Xóa khóa học', message: `Hành động này không thể hoàn tác. Xóa vĩnh viễn ${idsLabel(ids)}?`, confirmLabel: 'Xóa vĩnh viễn', danger: true, onConfirm: () => { removeCourses(ids, `Đã xóa ${idsLabel(ids)}.`); clearSelection() } })\n\n  const openMenu = (e, id) => { e.stopPropagation(); const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(); setMenu(menu && menu.id === id ? null : { id, x: r.right, y: r.bottom }) }\n  const openDrawer = c => { setDrawer(c); setDrawerTab('info'); requestAnimationFrame(() => setDrawerShow(true)) }\n  const closeDrawer = () => { setDrawerShow(false); setTimeout(() => setDrawer(null), 280) }\n\n  const exportExcel = () => {\n    const headers = ['ID', 'Khóa học', 'Gia sư', 'Môn học', 'Học viên', 'Số bài', 'Đánh giá', 'Giá', 'Trạng thái', 'Cập nhật', 'Doanh thu (đ)']\n    const rows = sorted.map(c => [c.id, c.title, c.tutor, c.subject, c.students, c.lessons, c.rating, c.price === 0 ? 'Miễn phí' : c.price, c.status, fmtDMY(c.updated), c.revenue])\n    const esc = v => `\"${String(v).replace(/\"/g, '\"\"')}\"`\n    const csv = '﻿' + [headers, ...rows].map(r => r.map(esc).join(',')).join('\\n')\n    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' })\n    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)\n    const a = document.createElement('a')\n    a.href = url; a.download = `khoa-hoc-edux-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`\n    a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url)\n    showToast(`Đã xuất ${sorted.length} khóa học ra Excel.`)\n  }\n\n  const STATS = [\n    { label: 'Tổng khóa học', value: '1,284', icon: 'school',      iconBg: 'bg-blue-50',    iconColor: 'text-blue-700',    trend: '+12%', up: true },\n    { label: 'Đang hoạt động', value: '986',  icon: 'check_circle', iconBg: 'bg-emerald-50', iconColor: 'text-emerald-700', trend: '+6%',  up: true },\n    { label: 'Chờ duyệt',     value: '72',    icon: 'hourglass_top', iconBg: 'bg-amber-50',  iconColor: 'text-amber-700',   trend: '+18%', up: false },\n    { label: 'Doanh thu',     value: '3.2 tỷ', icon: 'payments',    iconBg: 'bg-violet-50',  iconColor: 'text-violet-700',  trend: '+22%', up: true },\n  ]\n\n  const SortHead = ({ label, k, align = 'left' }) => (\n    <th className={`py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-on-surface-variant uppercase whitespace-nowrap ${align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : ''}`}>\n      <button onClick={() => toggleSort(k)} className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-primary transition-colors ${align === 'right' ? 'flex-row-reverse' : ''}`}>\n        {label}\n        <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[15px]\">{sort.key === k ? (sort.dir === 'asc' ? 'arrow_upward' : 'arrow_downward') : 'unfold_more'}</span>\n      </button>\n    </th>\n  )\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-10 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto w-full\">\n      {/* Header */}\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:justify-between lg:items-end gap-4 mb-8\">\n        <div>\n          <h2 className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-on-background\">Quản lý khóa học</h2>\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-on-surface-variant mt-1\">Theo dõi, kiểm duyệt và quản lý toàn bộ khóa học trên hệ thống EduX.</p>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <button onClick={exportExcel} className=\"px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-outline-variant text-on-surface rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors shadow-sm\">\n            <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-emerald-600\">file_download</span> Xuất Excel\n          </button>\n          <button onClick={() => showToast('Mở trình tạo khóa học mới.')} className=\"px-4 py-2.5 bg-primary text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-primary/90 transition-colors shadow-sm\">\n            <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]\">add</span> Tạo khóa học\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Stat cards */}\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5 mb-6\">\n        {STATS.map((s, i) => (\n          <div key={i} className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border border-outline-variant hover:shadow-md transition-shadow\">\n            <div className=\"flex justify-between items-start mb-4\">\n              <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-lg ${s.iconBg} flex items-center justify-center ${s.iconColor}`}>\n                <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined\">{s.icon}</span>\n              </div>\n              <span className={`flex items-center text-xs font-semibold ${s.up ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-amber-600'}`}>\n                <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[15px]\">{s.up ? 'trending_up' : 'trending_up'}</span>{s.trend}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n            <p className=\"text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wider mb-1\">{s.label}</p>\n            <h4 className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-on-background\">{s.value}</h4>\n          </div>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Table card */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-outline-variant overflow-hidden mb-6\">\n        {/* Toolbar / bulk bar */}\n        {selected.size > 0 ? (\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-3 border-b border-outline-variant bg-primary/5\">\n            <span className=\"text-sm font-semibold text-primary\">{selected.size} đã chọn</span>\n            <div className=\"h-5 w-px bg-outline-variant\" />\n            <button onClick={() => doApprove([...selected])} className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors\">\n              <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]\">check_circle</span> Duyệt\n            </button>\n            <button onClick={() => doArchive([...selected])} className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors\">\n              <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]\">inventory_2</span> Lưu trữ\n            </button>\n            <button onClick={() => doDelete([...selected])} className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors\">\n              <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]\">delete</span> Xóa\n            </button>\n            <button onClick={clearSelection} className=\"ml-auto px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors\">Bỏ chọn</button>\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center gap-3 px-6 py-4 border-b border-outline-variant\">\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap\">\n              {C_CHIPS.map(c => {\n                const count = c.match ? courses.filter(c.match).length : courses.length\n                const active = statusFilter === c.key\n                return (\n                  <button key={c.key} onClick={() => setStatusFilter(c.key)}\n                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 ${active ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'bg-gray-100 text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-gray-200'}`}>\n                    {c.key}\n                    <span className={`text-[11px] px-1.5 rounded-full ${active ? 'bg-white/20' : 'bg-white'}`}>{count}</span>\n                  </button>\n                )\n              })}\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"lg:ml-auto relative w-full lg:w-72 shrink-0\">\n              <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-on-surface-variant text-[18px]\">search</span>\n              <input value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n                className=\"w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-outline-variant rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all\"\n                placeholder=\"Tìm theo tên khóa học, ID hoặc gia sư...\" />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {/* Table */}\n        <div className=\"overflow-x-auto\">\n          <table className=\"w-full text-left min-w-[1180px]\">\n            <thead className=\"bg-gray-50 border-b border-outline-variant\">\n              <tr>\n                <th className=\"py-3 pl-6 pr-2 w-10\">\n                  <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={allPageSelected} ref={el => { if (el) el.indeterminate = !allPageSelected && somePageSelected }} onChange={togglePageAll}\n                    className=\"rounded border-outline-variant text-primary focus:ring-primary/30 cursor-pointer\" />\n                </th>\n       "type": "thinking",
      "thinking": "Now I have a comprehensive picture of the entire system. Let me write the architectural review.\n\nKey findings:\n1. **Business model mismatch**: The admin is built as if EduX is an LMS/Course Marketplace, when it's actually a Tutor Marketplace. The sidebar's center of gravity is \"Khóa học\" but there's no Booking/Session management at all in the admin.\n\n2. **Sidebar structure**: 11 top-level items, mixing concerns: Tutor approval + user management are separate but really belong to a \"People\" domain. Course management is one isolated item but service types (Group Class, Offline Class, Recorded Course, Documents, Mentoring) have no representation. \n\n3. **Domains are poorly organized**: Subjects should be grouped into a config/catalog section rather than standing alone. The Transactions domain is bloated with 17 sub-items that likely aren't all in use, while the Services domain is mislabeled—it handles complaints and reviews instead of representing actual tutor services. There's no dedicated Booking Center, Learning Center for sessions and schedules, or AI Center.\n\n4. **Navigation is underdeveloped**: The sidebar uses a flat accordion structure with no breadcrumbs, the global search doesn't function, and the entire state management relies on a single `activeView` string.\n\n5. **Permissions are overly simplistic**: Only an admin role exists with no differentiation for sub-admins, content moderators, or finance teams—it's an all-or-nothing `requireAdmin` check.\n\n6. **Database schema has critical gaps**: There's no dedicated `bookings` table, no `services` table for a catalog, and `transactions` isn't properly defined in the schema despite being referenced. The `lessons` table is tied to `classes` which conflates virtual classrooms with service offerings. Missing entirely are tables for service listings, bookings, sessions, payments, reviews, and earnings.\n\n7. **API design**\n\n—the server.js file is over 6000 lines with everything inlined, including duplicate routes like `GET /api/admin/tutors/stats` appearing twice and `GET /api/courses` appearing three times. học\" chuyển vào đây)\n\n**Navigation:** `/admin/services`, `/admin/services/courses`, `/admin/services/group-classes`, v.v.\n\n**Relationships:**\n- Service → Tutor (who created it)\n- Service → Bookings (Service Center ↔ Booking Center)\n- Service → Reviews (student reviews on service)\n- Service → Revenue (Finance Center)\n\n**KPI:**\n- Total active services by type\n- Services pending review (nếu có quy trình review nội dung)\n- Best-selling services (by booking count)\n- Revenue by service type\n\n**Analytics:**\n- Service type distribution\n- Enrollment/booking trend per service\n- Average rating by service type\n- Dropout/completion rate (Recorded Courses)\n\n**Permissions:**\n- `content_moderator`: review, flag, request edit\n- `admin`: hide, archive, force unpublish\n- `super_admin`: delete, refund all enrollees\n\n**Drawer (Service Quick View):**\n- Tab **Thông tin**: title, type, subject, tutor, price, status, created date\n- Tab **Nội dung**: (Recorded Course only) module → lesson hierarchy\n- Tab **Thống kê**: enrollment count, revenue, rating, completion\n- Tab **Đánh giá**: student reviews, flagged reviews\n- Tab **Lịch sử kiểm duyệt**: moderation actions\n\n**Actions:**\n- Hide / Unhide\n- Archive\n- Force unpublish (remove from marketplace)\n- Flag for content review\n- Override price cap\n- Export student list\n\n---\n\n### Domain 5: Booking Center\n\n**Purpose:**\nĐây là **trái tim của Tutor Marketplace**. Mọi kết nối Tutor ↔ Student đều đi qua đây. Admin cần nhìn thấy, giám sát và can thiệp vào booking flow.\n\n**Main Pages:**\n- **All Bookings** — table với filter: All | Pending | Confirmed | In Progress | Completed | Cancelled | Disputed\n- **Live Sessions** — bookings đang diễn ra hôm nay (realtime)\n- **Schedule Overview** — calendar view của tất cả sessions (across all tutors)\n- **Disputes** — bookings có tranh chấp (hiện tại nằm trong Transaction domain — SAI chỗ)\n\n**Navigation:** `/admin/bookings`, `/admin/bookings/:id`, `/admin/bookings/disputes`\n\n**Relationships:**\n- Booking → Student + Parent\n- Booking → Tutor + Service\n- Booking → Payment/Escrow (Finance Center)\n- Booking → Reviews (after completion)\n- Booking → Dispute (Moderation Center)\n\n**KPI:**\n- Bookings today (total, completed, upcoming)\n- Cancellation rate (7 ngày)\n- Dispute rate (số bookings bị dispute / total)\n- Average session completion rate\n- No-show rate (tutor / student)\n\n**Analytics:**\n- Booking volume trend (daily/weekly/monthly)\n- Peak booking hours heatmap\n- Cancellation reasons breakdown\n- Average booking lead time (đặt trước bao lâu)\n- Repeat booking rate (students booking same tutor again)\n\n**Permissions:**\n- `support_staff`: view, add note, contact participants\n- `admin`: cancel booking, trigger manual escrow release\n- `super_admin`: full override, force refund\n\n**Drawer (Booking Quick View):**\n- Tab **Chi tiết**: student, tutor, service, date/time, location (online/offline), status, notes\n- Tab **Thanh toán**: amount, escrow status, payment method, timeline\n- Tab **Lịch sử**: status changes, who changed, timestamps\n- Tab **Tranh chấp**: dispute details nếu có, admin notes, resolution\n\n**Actions:**\n- Cancel booking (with reason, trigger refund policy)\n- Manually release escrow (when tutor confirmed but student disputes)\n- Manually hold escrow (fraud suspicion)\n- Contact student / tutor (open message thread)\n- Mark as resolved\n- Flag for investigation\n\n---\n\n### Domain 6: Finance Center\n\n**Purpose:**\nGiám sát luồng tiền của toàn platform — thu nhập gia sư, commission, VNPay transactions, withdrawals, refunds, fraud detection.\n\n**Main Pages (consolidated từ 17 items hiện tại xuống 6 pages có nghĩa):**\n- **Financial Overview** — platform P&L, GMV, commission earned, pending payouts\n- **Transactions** — tất cả payment transactions (filter: type, status, date range, amount)\n- **Tutor Payouts** — withdrawal requests (pending approval, history)\n- **Refunds** — refund requests và history\n- **Commissions** — commission rates, overrides, history\n- **Fraud & Alerts** — suspicious transactions, flagged patterns\n\n**Navigation:** `/admin/finance`, `/admin/finance/transactions`, `/admin/finance/payouts`, v.v.\n\n**Relationships:**\n- Transaction → Booking (Finance ↔ Booking Center)\n- Transaction → Tutor (payout)\n- Transaction → Student (refund)\n- Fraud Alert → Booking, User\n\n**KPI:**\n- Platform GMV (month to date)\n- Commission earned (revenue)\n- Pending payouts (value + count)\n- Pending refunds (value + count)\n- Failed transaction rate\n- Fraud alerts open\n\n**Analytics:**\n- Revenue trend (daily, weekly, monthly)\n- Commission breakdown by service type\n- Top earning tutors\n- Payment method distribution (VNPay, wallet...)\n- Refund rate by tutor / service type\n- Average transaction value\n\n**Permissions:**\n- `finance_manager`: view all, approve payouts, process refunds\n- `admin`: same + override commission\n- `super_admin`: same + manual transaction injection (audit logged)\n- `support_staff`: view only\n\n**Drawer (Transaction Quick View):**\n- Tab **Chi tiết**: amount, type, user, booking reference, payment method, timestamp\n- Tab **Escrow**: hold/release timeline, who triggered each step\n- Tab **Lịch sử**: status changes, admin actions\n\n**Actions:**\n- Approve / reject payout\n- Process refund (full / partial)\n- Hold escrow\n- Release escrow\n- Flag as fraud\n- Export transaction report (CSV/Excel)\n\n---\n\n### Domain 7: Moderation Center\n\n**Purpose:**\nQuality & Safety — xử lý tất cả vấn đề liên quan đến nội dung, hành vi, tranh chấp về chất lượng. **Đây là \"Quản lý dịch vụ\" đổi tên đúng** và mở rộng.\n\n**Main Pages:**\n- **Complaints** — khiếu nại từ student/parent về tutor hoặc service (giữ lại `Complaints.jsx`)\n- **Reported Reviews** — đánh giá bị báo cáo là fake/offensive (giữ lại `Reviews.jsx`)\n- **Content Violations** — nội dung vi phạm: khóa học có vấn đề bản quyền, profile không phù hợp (giữ lại `Violations.jsx`)\n- **Content Review Queue** — nội dung chưa được review trước khi published (cái `sm-moderation` đang placeholder)\n- **Appeal Center** — tutor hoặc student kháng cáo quyết định của admin\n\n**Navigation:** `/admin/moderation`, `/admin/moderation/complaints`, v.v.\n\n**Relationships:**\n- Complaint → Booking (nếu complaint về một session cụ thể)\n- Complaint → Tutor (nếu complaint về tutor)\n- Violation → Service (nếu violation về course/content)\n- Dispute → Finance Center (nếu complaint đi kèm refund request)\n\n**KPI:**\n- Open complaints (chưa xử lý)\n- Average resolution time\n- Violation rate (flagged content / total content)\n- Repeat offenders (users/tutors with multiple complaints)\n- Appeal success rate\n\n**Analytics:**\n- Complaint categories breakdown\n- Resolution outcomes\n- Tutor quality score trend\n- Content violation types\n\n**Permissions:**\n- `content_moderator`: review content violations, flag reviews\n- `support_staff`: handle complaints, contact users\n- `admin`: ban users, remove content, override decisions\n- `super_admin`: full\n\n**Drawer (Complaint Quick View):**\n- Tab **Chi tiết**: reporter, subject, category, description, attachments, priority\n- Tab **Liên quan**: linked booking/service/tutor\n- Tab **Lịch sử xử lý**: actions taken, notes, timestamps, staff who handled\n- Tab **Trao đổi**: internal discussion thread giữa admin staff về case này\n\n**Actions:**\n- Assign to staff\n- Change priority (Low / Medium / High / Critical)\n- Add internal note\n- Contact reporter / reported party\n- Link to Finance (trigger refund)\n- Link to Tutor Center (trigger suspension)\n- Resolve / Close / Escalate\n\n---\n\n### Domain 8: Reports & Analytics\n\n**Purpose:**\nBusiness intelligence cho leadership Analytics** — acquisition, retention, churn\n- **Revenue Analytics** — P&L, forecasting, cohort analysis\n- **Tutor Analytics** — supply quality, utilization rate, top performers\n- **Learning Analytics** — completion rates, outcomes, popular subjects\n- **Custom Reports** — build-your-own với date range + dimensions + metrics\n\n**Navigation:** `/admin/reports`\n\n**Relationships:** Pulls admin roles: read\n- `super_admin`: export raw data\n\n**Actions:**\n- Export report (PDF / Excel / CSV)\n- Schedule automated email report\n- Share report link\n\n---\n\n### Domain 9: AI Bảng lessons ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n33\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lessons (\n34\t  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n35\t  course_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n36\t  module_title  TEXT NOT NULL,           -- Tên module (VD: \"Module 1: Visual Design\")\n37\t  lesson_title  TEXT NOT NULL,           -- Tên bài học cụ thể\n38\t  lesson_order  INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- Thứ tự sắp xếp trong module\n39\t  duration      TEXT,                    -- VD: \"15:00\", \"45:00\"\n40\t  status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'locked'\n41\t                CHECK (status IN ('completed', 'in_progress', 'locked')),\n42\t  video_url     TEXT,\n43\t  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n44\t  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n45\t);\n46\t\n47\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lessons_course_id ON lessons(course_id);\n48\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lessons_order     ON lessons(course_id, lesson_order);\n49\t\n50\tCREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_lessons_updated_at\n51\tBEFORE UPDATE ON lessons\n52\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n53\t\n54\t\n55\t-- ── 3. Bảng assignments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n56\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignments (\n57\t  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n58\t  course_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n59\t  title       TEXT NOT NULL,\n60\t  description TEXT,\n61\t  due_date    DATE,\n62\t  points      INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n63\t  status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'locked'\n64\t              CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'submitted', 'graded', 'locked')),\n65\t  score       INT,                       -- Điểm đã chấm (NULL nếu chưa chấm)\n66\t  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n67\t  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n68\t);\n69\t\n70\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_course_id ON assignments(course_id);\n71\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_status    ON assignments(status);\n72\t\n73\tCREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_assignments_updated_at\n74\tBEFORE UPDATE ON assignments\n75\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n76\t\n77\t\n78\t-- ── 4. Bảng materials ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n79\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS materials (\n80\t  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n81\t  course_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n82\t  title       TEXT NOT NULL,\n83\t  file_url    TEXT,                       -- Link file trên Supabase Storage\n84\t  file_type   TEXT,                       -- VD: \"pdf\", \"sketch\", \"figma\", \"doc\"\n85\t  file_size   TEXT,                       -- VD: \"2.4 MB\"\n86\t  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n87\t  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n88\t);\n89\t\n90\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_materials_course_id ON materials(course_id);\n91\t\n92\tCREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_materials_updated_at\n93\tBEFORE UPDATE ON materials\n94\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n95\t\n96\t\n97\t-- ── 5. Bảng course_progress ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n98\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_progress (\n99\t  id                UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n100\t  course_id         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n101\t  student_id        UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n102\t  completed_lessons INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n103\t  total_lessons     INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n104\t  progress_percent  NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,  -- VD: 45.00\n105\t  xp_points         INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n106\t  created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n107\t  updated_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n108\t\n109\t  -- Mỗi student chỉ có 1 record tiến độ cho mỗi course\n110\t  UNIQUE(course_id, student_id)\n111\t);\n112\t\n113\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_progress_course_id  ON course_progress(course_id);\n114\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_progress_student_id ON course_progress(student_id);\n115\t\n116\tCREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_progress_updated_at\n117\tBEFORE UPDATE ON course_progress\n118\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n119\t"
    }
  ]
}

API Design\n\n**Vẫn còn vấn đề cũ + có route mới:**\n\n**Route mới quan trọng:**\n- `POST /api/tutors/matches` — AI matching với scoring algorithm thực (subject +35, format +15, budget +15, city +10, experience +15 max, rating +5). **Tốt — đây là core marketplace logic.**\n- `/api/student/my-tutors` — endpoint mới (thấy trong `MyTutorsPage.jsx`) nhưng không xuất hiện trong grep server.js → có thể nằm ở cuối file hoặc trong một route file riêng chưa load.\n- `/api/tutor-interaction/:tutorId` — endpoint cho `TutorInteractionPage`, cũng không xuất hiện trong grep → route mới nhưng chưa verify tồn tại.\n\n**Vấn đề cũ chưa giải quyết:**\n- Duplicate routes vẫn còn (confirm qua grep trước).\n- `server.js` vẫn là monolith 6000+ dòng.\n- Không có API versioning.\n- Không có admin routes cho matching analytics, student-tutor relationships, booking management.\n\n**Vấn đề mới:**\n- `POST /api/tutors/matches` không có auth guard — bất kỳ ai cũng có thể POST và get danh sách toàn bộ approved tutors với dữ liệu cá nhân. Thích hợp làm public search nhưng cần rate limiting.\n- Score algorithm trong `matches` endpoint bị hardcode trực tiếp trong route handler — không extract ra service layer, không testable.\n\n---\n\n### 7. UX\n\n**Vấn đề cũ + phát hiện mới:**\n\n- AI Complaints Engine (`admin/ai/`) có UI **toàn bộ tiếng Anh** (Total Cases Today, AI Auto Resolved, Automation Rate, Needs Review, Critical Alerts, OVERDUE, DUE SOON, ON TRACK) trong khi toàn bộ admin còn lại là tiếng Việt — **ngôn ngữ không nhất quán**.\n- `Complaints.jsx` có `AIOperationsDashboard` hiển thị stats nhưng tất cả data đến từ `complaints` prop (mock data từ `admin/services/mockData.js`) — AI engine chạy thực nhưng context data (`buildCaseContext`) vẫn là mock (`fetchUserHistory`, `fetchTutorMetrics`, `fetchTransactionStatus` đều hardcode).\n- `FindTutorRequest` — 14-step wizard, excellent UX cho student, nhưng không có progress indicator đủ mạnh, không có \"save and continue later\" state persistence (chỉ dùng `localStorage` key `findTutorProgress`).\n- `TutorMatchesPage` có `CompareModal` — tốt, nhưng comparison data là offline, không lưu analytics về what students compare.\n- Dashboard main vẫn toàn hardcode mock.\n\n---\n\n### 8. Scalability\n\n**Vấn đề cũ + vấn đề mới:**\n\n- App.jsx đang import tất cả 30+ pages đồng bộ tại top level — bundle size ngày càng tăng. Hiện tại đã có `FindTutorRequest`, `TutorMatchesPage` thêm vào không có lazy loading.\n- `admin/ai/engine/index.js` gọi `mockAIEngine` → **cứng nhắc**: khi cần switch sang real Gemini API (đã có `backend/gemini.js`), phải sửa trực tiếp engine file thay vì inject dependency.\n- AI engine dùng callback pattern (`setAuditLogCallback`) để decouple từ React state — đây là anti-pattern trong React, sẽ gây bug khi component unmount/remount.\n\n---\n\n### 9. Maintainability\n\n**Có cải thiện thực sự:**\n\n- `admin/ai/` có cấu trúc tốt: **config → aggregator → engine** — separation of concerns rõ ràng.\n- `admin/ai/config.js` extract tất cả constants (SLA targets, action codes, thresholds) — không hardcode.\n- `admin/ai/engine/actionEngine.js` tuân thủ Single Responsibility Principle: `performAction` + `appendAuditLog` tách biệt.\n\n**Vấn đề còn lại:**\n\n- 20+ patch files ở root directory vẫn còn.\n- `admin/services/auditMockData.js` và `admin/transactions/AuditLogs.jsx` — audit data ở hai nơi khác nhau, không unified.\n- `constants/vietnamProvinces.js` — tốt, extract ra file riêng.\n- `utils/courseImage.js` — một utility file nhỏ, không rõ purpose.\n- Complaints.jsx vừa import từ `admin/transactions/components` (PageHeader, StatusBadge, SearchFilterBar, EmptyState, ModalOverlay) — cross-domain import, tạo coupling giữa transactions và services modules.\n\n---\n\n### 10. Business Logic\n\n**Có tiến bộ đáng kể ở phía Student/Tutor — nhưng Admin vẫn mù:**\n\n**Luồng mới được xây dựng (TỐTVÀ ĐÚNG HƯỚNG cho Tutor Marketplace):**\n\n```\nStudent điền 14-step form (nhu cầu học, ngân sách, lịch, phong cách...)\n  ↓\nPOST /api/tutors/matches (scoring algorithm thực)\n  ↓\nTutorMatchesPage (hiển thị ranked tutors, CompareModal)\n  ↓\nStudent chọn → TutorInteractionPage (notes, favorite)\n  ↓\nMyTutorsPage (danh sách tutors đang học)\n```\n\n**Đây đúng là Tutor Marketplace flow.** Vấn đề là:\n\n1. **Matching request không được persist** — `POST /api/tutors/matches` chỉ return kết quả, không lưu request vào DB. Admin không biết bao nhiêu requests được tạo, conversion rate là bao nhiêu.\n2. **Student-Tutor relationship không được formalize** — `MyTutorsPage` gọi `/api/student/my-tutors` nhưng không rõ \"my tutor\" được tạo ra từ đâu (booking? manual follow? matching acceptance?).\n3. **AI Matching score algorithm** (rule-based, không có ML) tốt cho MVP nhưng rating được hardcode là 0 cho tất cả tutors trong matches query (`0 AS rating, 0 AS review_count`) — matching score không accurate.\n4. **AI Complaints Engine** — thiết kế tốt (hard rules → AI evaluation → anti-abuse → action), nhưng tất cả context data (`buildCaseContext`) vẫn là mock. Khi connect real data, `fetchLessonContext` cần join log data (tutor/student join time) nhưng log đó hiện tại chưa có trong schema.\n5. `tutor-exam` và `tutor-exam-result` được thêm vào routing nhưng không có trong sidebar Tutor Dashboard, không rõ trigger từ đâu.\n\n---\n\n## PHẦN 2 — ĐÁNH GIÁ NHỮNG CẢI THIỆN THỰC SỰ TRONG V2\n\nĐể công bằng, những thứ được thêm vào đều có giá trị:\n\n| Cải thiện | Đánh giá |\n|---|---|\n| `admin/ai/` config/engine/aggregator pattern | ✅ Solid architecture, proper separation |\n| AI SLA tracking, anti-abuse rules | ✅ Production-grade thinking |\n| `POST /api/tutors/matches` với scoring algorithm | ✅ Core marketplace feature, connected API |\n| 14-step `FindTutorRequest` wizard | ✅ Rich UX, correct business flow |\n| `TutorMatchesPage` với CompareModal | ✅ Good discovery UX |\n| `course_detail_schema.sql` — proper courses table | ✅ Better than inline classes |\n| `constants/vietnamProvinces.js` | ✅ Proper extraction |\n\n---\n\n## PHẦN 3 — ĐỀ XUẤT KIẾN TRÚC MỚI (Revised & Updated)\n\n---\n\n### Nguyên tắc (cập nhật)\n\n1. **Tutor Marketplace = Matching + Booking + Payment.** Sidebar phải phản ánh điều này.\n2. **AI là cross-cutting concern**, không phải một isolated domain. AI engine cho complaints đã chứng minh điều này — nó serve Moderation domain, không phải AI domain riêng.\n3. **Mỗi domain có hai chiều**: Operational (xem, hành động, xử lý) + Analytics (KPI, trends).\n4. **Lazy load mọi domain module** — bundle không tăng khi thêm domain mới.\n5. **Mock data phải có env switch** — không bao giờ render mock cho production admin.\n\n---\n\n### Proposed Sidebar\n\n```\nEduX Admin\n│\n├── 📊  Tổng quan              /admin\n│\n├── ─── PEOPLE ──────────────\n├── 👤  User Center            /admin/users\n├── 🎓  Tutor Center           /admin/tutors\n│\n├── ─── CORE OPERATIONS ──────\n├── 🔍  Matching Center        /admin/matching       ← MỚI — AI matching analytics\n├── 📅  Booking Center         /admin/bookings       ← MỚI — session management\n├── 🛍️  Service Center         /admin/services       ← RENAME từ \"Khóa học\"\n│\n├── ─── FINANCE ─────────────\n├── 💰  Finance Center         /admin/finance        ← COLLAPSE 17 items → 6 pages\n│\n├── ─── QUALITY & SAFETY ────\n├── 🛡️  Moderation Center      /admin/moderation     ← RENAME từ \"Quản lý dịch vụ\"\n│\n├── ─── INTELLIGENCE ────────\n├── 📈  Analytics              /admin/analytics\n│\n└── ─── SYSTEM ──────────────\n    ⚙️  Settings               /admin/settings       ← absorbs Môn học, Audit Logs\n```\n\n**9 top-level domains.** Giảm từ 11 xuống 9. Không có accordion — mỗi domain tự quản lý sub-navigation bên trong.\n\n---\n\n## PHẦN 4 — MÔ TẢ TỪNG DOMAIN (Updated)\n\n---\n\n### Domain 1: Dashboard (Tổng quan)\n\n**Purpose:** Real-time command center. Platform GMV tháng này (từ Finance Center)\n- AI matching requests hôm nay vs. converted bookings\n- Critical alerts (SLA overdue, fraud flags)\n\n**Analytics:**\n- Booking volume trend (7 ngày)\n- Revenue trend (30 ngày)\n- User growth (30 ngày)\n- Top subjects by matching requests\n\n**Permissions:** Read-only cho mọi admin role.\n\n**Detail View:** Click KPI card → deep link vào domain tương ứng với filter pre-applied.\n\n**Actions:** Acknowledge alert, navigate to issue.\n\n---\n\n### Domain 2: User Center\n\n**Purpose:** Quản lý identity — Students, Parents, Admin accounts.\n\n**Main Domain 4: Matching Center ← MỚI\n\n**Purpose:** Giám sát và tối ưu hóa AI Matching — đây là **competitive advantage** của EduX so với listing-only tutor marketplaces. Admin cần thấy matching funnel để cải thiện conversion.\n\n**Main Pages:**\n- **Matching Overview** — funnel analytics\n- **Matching Requests** — danh sách requests (`POST /api/tutors/matches` được được compare, nào được book\n\n**Actions:** Export report, trigger re-match với weights mới, flag low-quality results.\n\n> **Lý do tách riêng Domain này:** `POST /api/tutors/matches` đang chạy thực nhưng không persist request data, `rating = 0` bug cần được track và fixed từ admin, và matching conversion là metric chiến lược nhất của một Tutor Marketplace.\n\n---\n\n### Domain 5: Booking Center schedule_preferences (JSON), learning_goals (JSON),\n  created_at, converted_booking_id (NULL until booked)\n\nbookings:\n  id, student_id, tutor_id, service_id,\n  session_date, duration_minutes,\n  format (online/offline), location,\n  status (requested|confirmed|in_progress|completed|cancelled|disputed),\n  amount, escrow_status (held|released|refunded),\n  cancellation_reason, created_at, updated_at\n\ntransactions:\n  id, booking_id, type (payment|refund|payout|commission),\n  amount, currency (VND),\n  gateway (vnpay|wallet|bank_transfer),\n  gateway_txn_id, status (initiated|processing|completed|failed),\n  created_at\n\nwithdrawals:\n  id, tutor_id, amount, bank_account (JSON),\n  status (requested|pending_verification|approved|processing|completed|rejected),\n  rejected_reason, processed_at\n\ncomplaints:\n  id, case_id (human-readable: CASE-2026-XXX),\n  reporter_id, reporter_role (student|tutor|parent),\n  target_id, target_type (tutor|student|service|system),\n  title, content, attachments[],\n  severity (CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW),\n  status (OPEN|AI_ASSESSED|AWAITING_ADMIN|IN_REVIEW|RESOLVED|CLOSED_BY_AI|REOPENED),\n  ai_result (JSON), linked_dispute_id, linked_booking_id,\n  assigned_to (admin_id), created_at, resolved_at, sla_deadline\n```\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 5 — ENTITY LIFECYCLES\n\n### 5.1 Tutor Lifecycle\n\n```\n                    [REGISTERED]\n                         │ submits tutor-profile form\n                         ▼\n                   [PENDING_REVIEW]\n                    ┌────┴────┐\n                    ▼         ▼\n              [APPROVED]   [REJECTED]\n                    │              │ reapply (after 30 days)\n                    │              └──────────────────┐\n                    ▼                                 ▼\n              [ACTIVE] ◄──────────────────── [PENDING_REVIEW]\n                    │\n             ┌──────┼──────┐\n             ▼      ▼      ▼\n        [FLAGGED] [WARN_1] [WARN_2]\n             │      │        │\n             │      └────────┘\n             ▼           │\n       [SUSPENDED]  (3rd violation)\n             │                  │\n    appealed │   appeal rejected│\n             ▼                  ▼\n      [APPEAL_REVIEW]     [OFFBOARDED]\n             │\n    ┌────────┴────────┐\n    ▼                 ▼\n[REINSTATED]    [OFFBOARDED]\n\nTriggers:\n  PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED:   Admin action + email sent\n  PENDING_REVIEW → REJECTED:   Admin action + reason + email sent\n  ACTIVE → FLAGGED:            Complaint threshold exceeded (auto)\n  ACTIVE → WARN_1:             1st violation confirmed\n  ACTIVE → WARN_2:             2nd violation confirmed\n  ACTIVE → SUSPENDED:          3rd violation OR critical violation\n  SUSPENDED → OFFBOARDED:      No appeal within 30 days\n  Any status → OFFBOARDED:     Super_admin manual action\n```\n\n### 5.2 Service Lifecycle\n\n```\n              [DRAFT]\n                 │ tutor publishes\n                 ▼\n             [ACTIVE]\n          ┌──────┼──────┐\n          ▼      ▼      ▼\n     [FLAGGED] [HIDDEN] [ARCHIVED]\n          │      │\n          ▼      │\n  [UNDER_REVIEW] │\n     ┌────┴───┐  │\n     ▼        ▼  ▼\n[REINSTATED] [REMOVED]\n\nNotes:\n  DRAFT → ACTIVE:       Tutor action (self-publish after approval)\n  ACTIVE → FLAGGED:     User report OR AI content check\n  ACTIVE → HIDDEN:      Admin action (temporary hide)\n  ACTIVE → ARCHIVED:    Tutor action OR admin action\n  FLAGGED → UNDER_REVIEW: Admin opens review\n  UNDER_REVIEW → REINSTATED: Admin clears\n  UNDER_REVIEW → REMOVED: Admin confirms violation\n```\n\n### 5.3 Course Lifecycle (subtype of Service)\n\n```\n           [DRAFT]\n              │ tutor publishes\n              ▼\n          [PUBLISHED]\n        ┌──────┼──────┐\n        ▼      ▼      ▼\n  [FLAGGED] [HIDDEN] [ARCHIVED]\n        │\n        ▼\n  [UNDER_CONTENT_REVIEW]\n        ┌────┴───┐\n        ▼        ▼\n[REINSTATED]  [REMOVED]\n                   │\n                   ▼\n            [REFUND_INITIATED]  ← trigger: refund all enrollees\n\nNotes:\n  Course is a Service with additional tracking:\n    → enrollment_count, completion_rate, rating\n  REMOVED triggers refund_policy check:\n    → if enrolled students exist → REFUND_INITIATED → Finance Center\n```\n\n### 5.4 Booking Lifecycle\n\n```\n           [REQUESTED]\n          ┌────┴────┐\n          ▼          ▼\n    [CONFIRMED]  [REJECTED_BY_TUTOR]\n          │         (escrow released)\n    ┌─────┤\n    ▼     ▼\n[CANCELLED] [IN_PROGRESS]\n(policy      │\n applies)    ▼\n         [COMPLETED]\n          ┌────┴────┐\n          ▼          ▼\n  [REVIEWED]    [DISPUTED]\n  (normal end)        │\n                ┌─────┴─────┐\n                ▼           ▼\n      [RESOLVED_REFUND] [RESOLVED_RELEASE]\n         (escrow→student)  (escrow→tutor)\n                       ▼\n                   (PARTIAL)  ← split escrow\n\nCancellation timing policy:\n  >24h before session: full refund\n  2-24h before session: 50% refund\n  <2h before session: no refund (tutor protected)\n  Tutor cancels anytime: full refund + compensation\n```\n\n### 5.5 Transaction Lifecycle\n\n```\n       [INITIATED]\n            │ gateway call\n            ▼\n       [PROCESSING]\n        ┌────┴────┐\n        ▼          ▼\n  [COMPLETED]   [FAILED]\n        │              │ retry logic\n        │              └──► [INITIATED] (max 3 retries)\n        ▼\n  [SETTLED]  ← escrow released\n        │\n        └──► [REFUND_INITIATED] ← dispute resolution\n                    │\n                    ▼\n             [REFUND_PROCESSING]\n                    │\n                    ▼\n             [REFUNDED]  ← terminal state\n\nNotes:\n  FAILED after 3 retries → notify Finance Center → fraud check\n  COMPLETED → escrow status: HELD until session completion\n  SETTLED → escrow status: RELEASED\n```\n\n### 5.6 Refund Lifecycle\n\n```\n         [REQUESTED]\n         (by user or triggered by admin)\n              │\n              ▼\n      [PENDING_FINANCE_REVIEW]\n          ┌────┴────┐\n          ▼          ▼\n      [APPROVED]   [REJECTED]\n          │              │ notification to requester\n          ▼\n      [PROCESSING]\n      (gateway/wallet call)\n          │\n          ▼\n      [COMPLETED]  ← money returned to source\n\nTriggers:\n  Dispute resolved in student's favor → auto REQUESTED\n  Admin action in Moderation → REQUESTED\n  Finance manager review → APPROVED / REJECTED\n```\n\n### 5.7 Complaint Lifecycle\n\n```\n           [SUBMITTED]\n                │\n                ▼\n          [AI_EVALUATING]\n          (buildCaseContext → evaluateCase)\n                │\n        ┌───────┴───────┐\n        ▼               ▼\n[CLOSED_BY_AI]    [AWAITING_ADMIN]\n(autoResolved=true)       │\n        │           ┌─────┴─────┐\n        │           ▼           ▼\n        │      [IN_REVIEW]  [ESCALATED]\n        │           │           │\n        │     ┌─────┴─────┐     │\n        │     ▼           ▼     ▼\n        │ [RESOLVED]  [DISPUTED] (→ Booking Center)\n        │\n        └──────────► [REOPENED] ← user disagrees with resolution\n                          │\n                          ▼\n                     [IN_REVIEW]  (re-enters queue)\n\nSLA timers (from AI_CONFIG):\n  CRITICAL: 1 hour\n  HIGH:     24 hours\n  MEDIUM:   48 hours\n  LOW:      72 hours\n\nAnti-abuse: user with >3 auto-resolved in 30 days → force AWAITING_ADMIN\n```\n\n### 5.8 Withdrawal Lifecycle\n\n```\n      [REQUESTED]\n      (tutor submits withdrawal)\n            │\n            ▼\n    [PENDING_VERIFICATION]\n    (system checks: sufficient balance,\n     no active disputes on earnings,\n     KYC status)\n          ┌────┴────┐\n          ▼          ▼\n    [VERIFIED]   [REJECTED]\n    (auto or         │ (with reason)\n     manual)         └── notification to tutor\n          │\n          ▼\n    [APPROVED]\n    (finance_manager approves)\n          │\n          ▼\n    [PROCESSING]\n    (bank transfer initiated)\n          │\n       ┌──┴──┐\n       ▼     ▼\n[COMPLETED] [FAILED]\n                │ retry\n                └──► [PROCESSING] (max 2 retries)\n                               │ still failed\n                               ▼\n                        [MANUAL_INTERVENTION]\n                        → notify Finance team\n```\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 6 — OPERATIONS CENTER\n\n### 6.1 Concept\n\nOperations Center là **unified task queue** — nơi admin bắt đầu ngày làm việc. Tất cả items cần human action từ mọi domain đều surface lên đây, được prioritize và assigned.\n\nKhông xử lý trực tiếp tại Operations Center — mọi action đều deep-link sang domain tương ứng. Operations Center chỉ là **aggregation + prioritization layer**.\n\n### 6.2 Item Sources\n\n```\nOPERATIONS CENTER\n│\n├── FROM Tutor Center:\n│     • Pending approval (tutor_profiles.status = 'pending')\n│     • Pending info request (tutor responded to doc request)\n│     • Suspended tutor appeal submitted\n│\n├── FROM Service Center:\n│     • Flagged content pending review\n│     • Reported violation under review\n│\n├── FROM Booking Center:\n│     • Open dispute (booking.status = 'DISPUTED')\n│     • No-show booking unresolved >2h\n│\n├── FROM Finance Center:\n│     • Payout request pending approval\n│     • Refund request pending review\n│     • Fraud alert flagged\n│     • Failed transaction (>3 retries)\n│\n├── FROM Moderation Center:\n│     • Complaint: AWAITING_ADMIN (AI couldn't resolve)\n│     • Complaint: CRITICAL severity (any — bypasses AI)\n│     • Complaint: SLA deadline in <2h\n│     • Reported review flagged\n│     • Appeal pending\n│\n└── FROM AI Engine:\n      • AI confidence <70% on any assessment → manual required\n      • Anti-abuse rule triggered (user exceeded threshold)\n```\n\n### 6.3 Item Structure\n\n```\nOperationsItem:\n  id:            string\n  source_domain: 'tutor' | 'service' | 'booking' | 'finance' | 'moderation'\n  source_id:     entity ID (tutor ID, complaint ID, booking ID...)\n  type:          'tutor_approval' | 'dispute' | 'payout' | 'complaint' |\n                 'refund' | 'fraud' | 'content_violation' | 'appeal'\n  priority:      'CRITICAL' | 'HIGH' | 'MEDIUM' | 'LOW'\n  sla_deadline:  ISO timestamp (when this MUST be resolved by)\n  sla_status:    'ON_TRACK' | 'DUE_SOON' | 'OVERDUE'\n  title:         string (human-readable: \"Complaint CP-001: Gia sư đi trễ\")\n  summary:       string (1-line context)\n  created_at:    ISO timestamp\n  assigned_to:   admin_id | null\n  status:        'OPEN' | 'IN_PROGRESS' | 'DONE'\n  deep_link:     URL to relevant domain/entity\n```\n\n### 6.4 Priority Calculation\n\n```\nPriority Rules (evaluated in order):\n\nCRITICAL:\n  - Complaint contains critical keywords (lừa đảo, quấy rối, tống tiền, đe dọa, bạo lực)\n  - Fraud alert (potential stolen card, suspicious transaction pattern)\n  - Payout dispute >50M VND\n  - SLA already overdue\n\nHIGH:\n  - Dispute involving amount >10M VND\n  - Complaint SLA deadline in <24h\n  - Payout request pending >48h\n  - Tutor with >500 active students pending approval\n  - CRITICAL complaint escalated from AI\n\nMEDIUM:\n  - Standard complaint AWAITING_ADMIN\n  - Payout request pending 24-48h\n  - Standard tutor approval\n  - Content violation flagged\n\nLOW:\n  - Content violation (no financial impact)\n  - Review flagged (offensive language)\n  - Payout request pending <24h\n  - New tutor appeal\n```\n\n### 6.5 SLA Policy\n\n```\nItem Type                    SLA Target    Source\n─────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCRITICAL complaint           1 hour        AI_CONFIG.sla.CRITICAL\nFraud alert                  1 hour        Finance policy\nHIGH complaint               24 hours      AI_CONFIG.sla.HIGH\nOpen dispute                 24 hours      Booking policy\nMEDIUM complaint             48 hours      AI_CONFIG.sla.MEDIUM\nPayout approval              48 hours      Finance policy\nTutor approval               72 hours      Platform policy\nLOW complaint                72 hours      AI_CONFIG.sla.LOW\nContent violation review     72 hours      Content policy\nRefund request               72 hours      Finance policy\n```\n\n### 6.6 Operations Center Views\n\n```\nViews:\n  1. My Queue         ← items assigned to logged-in admin\n  2. All Open         ← all unassigned + assigned items\n  3. Overdue          ← SLA breached\n  4. By Domain        ← filter: tutor | finance | moderation | booking\n  5. By Priority      ← CRITICAL first\n\nActions available from Operations Center:\n  - Assign to self\n  - Assign to another admin\n  - Change priority (with justification)\n  - Snooze (defer, with reason + expiry)\n  - Open in domain (deep link)\n  - Mark done (auto when domain resolves underlying item)\n```\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 7 — PERMISSION MATRIX\n\n### 7.1 Role Definitions\n\n```\nsuper_admin:      Full platform control. Can manage other admins.\n                  Responsible for platform config, billing, RBAC.\n\nadmin:            Daily operational control across all domains.\n                  Cannot manage other admins or change platform billing.\n\nfinance_manager:  Finance Center focus. Can approve payouts, process refunds.\n                  Read-only access to other domains for context.\n\ncontent_moderator: Service + Moderation Center. Can review/flag/remove content.\n                   Read-only booking and finance for context.\n\nsupport_staff:    User-facing support. Can view all. Limited write access.\n                  Handles complaints, contacts users, adds notes.\n```\n\n### 7.2 Permission Matrix\n\n```\nMODULE / ACTION              super  admin  finance  content actions)\n```\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 8 — AUDIT TRAIL\n\n### 8.1 Strategy\n\nAudit Trail là **immutable, append-only record** của mọi state change có significance trong hệ thống. Không xóa, không sửa. Chỉ append.\n\n### 8.2 Audit Entry Structure\n\n```\nAuditEntry:\n  id:            UUID (generated server-side)\n  timestamp:     ISO 8601 with milliseconds\n  actor_type:    'HUMAN' | 'AI_SYSTEM' | 'AUTOMATED' | 'API_EXTERNAL'\n  actor_id:      admin user ID | 'AI_ENGINE_v1' | 'CRON_JOB' | 'VNPAY_WEBHOOK'\n  actor_role:    role at time of action (snapshot — role may change)\n  actor_ip:      IPv4/IPv6 (for HUMAN actors)\n  actor_session: session ID (for HUMAN actors)\n\n  domain:        'tutor' | 'user' | 'service' | 'booking' |\n                 'finance' | 'moderation' | 'settings' | 'system'\n  entity_type:   'tutor_profile' | 'booking' | 'complaint' | 'transaction'...\n  entity_id:     the ID of the changed entity\n\n  action:        string (APPROVE_TUTOR | REJECT_TUTOR | SUSPEND_USER |\n                         RESOLVE_COMPLAINT | RELEASE_ESCROW | etc.)\n  action_label:  Vietnamese label for display\n\n  old_value:     JSON snapshot of entity before change (nullable)\n  new_value:     JSON snapshot of entity after change\n\n  metadata:      JSON — additional context\n                 (reason, notes, AI confidence, override rationale, etc.)\n  tags:          string[] (e.g., ['financial', 'high_value', 'ai_involved'])\n```\n\n### 8.3 Audit Coverage by Domain\n\n```\nDomain          Events logged\n────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nTutor Center    profile_status_changed, document_viewed, approval_email_sent\nUser Center     role_changed, suspended, banned, password_reset\nService Center  status_changed, price_overridden, content_removed\nBooking Center  status_changed, dispute_opened, dispute_resolved,\n                escrow_action (hold/release/refund)\nFinance Center  payout_approved, payout_rejected, refund_processed,\n                commission_changed, fraud_flagged\nModeration      complaint_assigned, ai_run, ai_overridden, complaint_resolved,\n                review_removed, violation_actioned, appeal_decided\nSettings        config_changed, feature_flag_toggled, admin_created,\n                role_assigned, ai_config_changed, gateway_configured\nSystem          login_attempt (failed), bulk_export, data_access_sensitive\n```\n\n### 8.4 Audit Access Rules\n\n```\nEntry type          Who can view\n────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nOwn actions         All admin roles (everyone sees what they did)\nDomain actions      Admins with access to that domain\nFinancial actions   finance_manager + admin + super_admin\nSettings actions    super_admin only\nSensitive docs      super_admin only (CCCD, certificates viewed)\nFull raw export     super_admin only\n```\n\n### 8.5 Audit Timeline UI (per entity)\n\nKhi xem bất kỳ entity nào (tutor, booking, complaint...) trong drawer, tab **Lịch sử** hiển thị:\n\n```\n[Timeline]\n│\n├── 2026-06-29 14:32:05  HUMAN (admin@edux.com)\n│   Action: APPROVE_TUTOR\n│   \"Đã duyệt hồ sơ gia sư. Ghi chú: Chứng chỉ hợp lệ, CCCD rõ ràng.\"\n│\n├── 2026-06-29 10:15:22  AI_SYSTEM (AI_ENGINE_v1)\n│   Action: AI_ASSESSED\n│   \"Đánh giá tự động: Hồ sơ đầy đủ, không cờ đỏ. Confidence: 82%.\"\n│\n├── 2026-06-27 09:00:00  HUMAN (tutor: T-001)\n│   Action: PROFILE_SUBMITTED\n│   \"Gia sư nộp hồ sơ lần đầu.\"\n│\n└── 2026-06-25 15:44:11  AUTOMATED (system)\n    Action: ACCOUNT_CREATED\n    \"Tài khoản được tạo qua Google OAuth.\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 9 — GLOBAL SEARCH\n\n### 9.1 Strategy\n\nGlobal Search là **unified, cross-entity search** với keyboard shortcut. Không phải per-domain search.\n\nTrigger: Header search box, hoặc `Ctrl+K` / `Cmd+K`.\n\n### 9.2 Search Scope\n\n```\nEntity Type       Searchable Fields                          Result Title\n──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nUser              name, email, phone, user ID               \"Student: Nguyễn Văn A\"\nTutor             name, email, subjects, tutor ID           \"Tutor: Trần Thị B\"\nService/Course    title, tutor name, subject, service ID    \"Course: Luyện thi Toán...\"\nBooking           booking ID, student name, tutor name      \"Booking BK-001\"\nTransaction       transaction ID, amount, gateway txn ID    \"Transaction TX-4421\"\nComplaint         case ID, title, reporter name             \"Complaint CASE-2026-001\"\nWithdrawal        withdrawal ID, tutor name, amount         \"Withdrawal WD-009\"\nPayout            same as withdrawal                        \"Payout PO-012\"\n```\n\n### 9.3 Search CENTER\n\n### 10.1 Notification Types\n\n```\nType          Description                                    Admin Action?\n────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nALERT         Requires action (SLA breach, critical case)     YES\nTASK          New item assigned to admin                      YES\nWARNING       Approaching SLA deadline (<2h)                  YES\nINFO          Informational (batch job done, report ready)    NO\nSUCCESS       Action confirmed (payout approved, etc.)        NO\nSYSTEM        Platform alerts (downtime, error spike)         admin+ only\n```\n\n### 10.2 Notification Sources\n\n```\nSource              Trigger                               Type\n──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nTutor Center        New pending approval                  TASK\n                    Tutor responded to doc request        TASK\n                    Approval SLA >72h approaching         WARNING\nBooking Center      New dispute opened                    TASK\n                    Dispute SLA approaching               WARNING\nFinance Center      Payout request submitted              TASK\n                    Fraud alert triggered                 ALERT\n                    Payout failed after processing        ALERT\nModeration          Complaint AWAITING_ADMIN              TASK\n                    CRITICAL complaint                    ALERT\n                    SLA breach                            ALERT\n                    AI could not resolve (confidence <70%)TASK\nAnalytics           Scheduled report ready                INFO\nSystem              AI engine error                       SYSTEM\n                    Payment gateway down                  SYSTEM (ALERT)\n```\n\n### 10.3 Notification Routing\n\n```\nRouting Rules:\n  ALERT (any domain)     → super_admin + admin + relevant role\n  CRITICAL complaint     → super_admin + admin (regardless of assignment)\n  Payout task           → finance_manager + admin + super_admin\n  Content violation      → content_moderator + admin + super_admin\n  Tutor approval         → admin + super_admin\n  Complaint task         → support_staff + content_moderator + admin\n  SYSTEM alert          → super_admin + admin only\n  Assignment-specific   → only assigned admin\n\nDelivery channels:\n  In-app (header bell icon):  all types\n  Email digest (daily):       ALERT + TASK only, grouped by domain\n  Real-time push (future):    CRITICAL + ALERT only\n```\n\n### 10.4 Notification Structure\n\n```\nNotification:\n  id:             UUID\n  recipient_id:   admin user ID\n  type:           ALERT | TASK | WARNING | INFO | SUCCESS | SYSTEM\n  domain:         source domain\n  entity_type:    source entity type\n  entity_id:      source entity ID\n  title:          string (short: \"Khiếu nại CRITICAL mới\")\n  body:           string (detail: \"Lê Văn A báo cáo vi phạm nghiêm trọng...\")\n  action_label:   string (\"Xem ngay\")\n  action_url:     deep link to entity in domain\n  is_read:        boolean\n  created_at:     ISO timestamp\n  expires_at:     ISO timestamp (notifications auto-expire after 30 days)\n```\n\n### 10.5 Notification Center UI Design\n\n```\n[Header: Bell icon with unread badge]\n  → click → dropdown (latest 10, grouped)\n\n[Full Notification Center: /admin/notifications]\n  Tabs: All | Unread | Alerts | Tasks\n  Filters: Domain | Date | Type\n  Actions:\n    - Mark all read\n    - Clear read notifications\n    - Per-notification: mark read, dismiss, open entity\n  Group by domain (collapsible)\n```\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 11 — AI CENTER (Embedded Architecture)\n\n### 11.1 Principle\n\nAI không phải là một domain sidebar. AI là capability layer embedded vào từng domain. Admin không \"đi vào AI\" — AI xuất hiện trong workflow tự nhiên của từng domain.\n\n### 11.2 AI Capabilities Map\n\n```\nDomain              AI Capability                     Status\n─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nTutor Center        Profile completeness scoring       ← design only\n                    Risk flagging (missing docs)       ← design only\nService Center      Content quality check              ← design only\n                    Plagiarism detection (future)      ← future\nBooking Center      No-show prediction (future)        ← future\nModeration          Complaint assessment + routing     ← IMPLEMENTED (mock LLM)\n                    Review sentiment analysis          ← design only\n                    Spam/fake review detection         ← design only\nDashboard           Platform health summary            ← partial (hardcoded)\nAnalytics           Anomaly detection                  ← design only\nMatching            Tutor-student matching score       ← IMPLEMENTED (rule-based)\n```\n\n### 11.3 AI Engine Architecture\n\n```\nINPUTS\n  complaint / content / profile / transaction\n       │\n       ▼\n[AGGREGATOR LAYER]\n  buildCaseContext(entity)\n  → fetchUserHistory(userId)\n  → fetchTutorMetrics(tutorId)\n  → fetchTransactionStatus(bookingId)\n  → fetchLessonContext(bookingId)\n       │ enrichedData\n       ▼\n[EVALUATION LAYER]\n  evaluateCase(enrichedData)\n  → HARD RULES CHECK (criticalKeywords → CRITICAL)\n  → LLM CALL (mockAIEngine → future: Gemini API)\n  → FRAUD PREVENTION (anti-abuse threshold)\n       │ aiResult: { severity, confidence, recommendation, actionCode, autoResolved }\n       ▼\n[ACTION LAYER]\n  executeAction(actionCode, caseId, actorType, actorId, updateCaseStatus)\n  → performAction(actionCode) → domain state change\n  → appendAuditLog(caseId, actorType, actorId, action, metadata)\n\nOUTPUTS\n  → Complaint status updated\n  → Audit entry created\n  → Notification sent if AWAITING_ADMIN\n  → Operations Center item created if needs human\n```\n\n### 11.4 AI Configuration (Settings > AI Config — super_admin only)\n\n```\nSettings:\n  LLM Provider:         Gemini | OpenAI | Mock (current)\n  Model:                gemini-1.5-pro | gpt-4o | ...\n  Confidence Threshold: 70 (below this → force manual review)\n  Critical Keywords:    [editable list]\n  SLA Targets:          CRITICAL:1h | HIGH:24h | MEDIUM:48h | LOW:72h\n  Anti-Abuse:           auto_resolve_threshold_30d: 3\n                        appeal_threshold_30d: 2\n  Matching Weights:     subject:35 | format:15 | budget:15 | city:10\n                        experience_max:15 | rating:5 | (sum=95+5=100)\n```\n\n### 11.5 AI Performance Monitoring (Analytics > AI Performance)\n\n```\nMetrics tracked:\n  Auto-resolution rate         (% complaints AI resolved without human)\n  Human override rate          (% AI decisions overturned by admin)\n  Confidence distribution      (histogram of confidence scores)\n  False positive rate          (auto-resolved complaints reopened)\n  SLA compliance by AI         (% AI-handled cases within SLA)\n  Matching conversion rate     (matches → bookings)\n  Fallback rate                (% matching requests used fallback tutors)\n  Average AI response time     (latency of LLM calls)\n```\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 12 — DASHBOARD KPI\n\n### 12.1 KPI (Sidebar Final)\n\n```\n/admin                     Dashboard\n/admin/ops                 Operations Center\n/admin/users               User Center\n/admin/tutors              Tutor Center\n/admin/services            Service Center\n/admin/bookings            Booking Center\n/admin/finance             Finance Center\n/admin/moderation          Moderation Center\n/admin/analytics           Analytics\n/admin/settings            Settings\n```\n\n### Cross-Domain Navigation Rules\n\n```\nRule 1 — Primary navigation via URL\n  Every entity has a canonical URL. Sidebar navigates by URL.\n\nRule 2 — Secondary context via Drawer\n  Viewing related entity without leaving current domain → drawer overlay.\n  Drawer shows read-only summary + \"Xem đầy đủ\" link.\n\nRule 3 — Actions stay in source domain\n  Trigger a Finance action from Moderation? → API call in background.\n  Toast confirms. User stays in Moderation.\n\nRule 4 — Ops Center as universal re-entry point\n  Any item requiring admin action always surfaces in Ops Center.\n  Admin can start their day from Ops Center without touching sidebar.\n\nRule 5 — Filter propagation\n  Analytics → Domain: URL carries filter params.\n  Receiving domain shows \"Đang lọc theo: [filter]\" with clear option.\n\nRule 6 — Audit trail follows entity, not domain\n  Audit log accessible from every entity drawer.\n  Full audit log in Settings for super_admin.\n```\n\n### Non-Negotiable Data Fixes Before Implementation\n\n```\n1. # EPIC 0.5 - Admin Blueprint

Chúng ta đã hoàn thành Architecture v2.

Từ thời điểm này KHÔNG được tiếp tục thay đổi kiến trúc tổng thể nếu không thực sự cần thiết.

Bây giờ hãy chuyển sang giai đoạn Product Blueprint.

Bạn sẽ đóng vai:

* Principal Product Manager
* Senior UX Architect
* Enterprise SaaS Designer

Không phải Software Engineer.

Không code.

Không tạo component.

Không viết React.

Không viết API.

Không thiết kế Database.

Chỉ thiết kế Blueprint.

====================================

BUSINESS MODEL

EduX là Tutor Marketplace.

Không phải Course Marketplace.

Tutor là trung tâm.

Tutor có thể cung cấp nhiều loại Service:

* Private Tutoring
* Group Class
* Recorded Course
* Offline Class
* Mentoring
* Documents

Course chỉ là một loại Service.

====================================

Mục tiêu của Blueprint:

Thiết kế toàn bộ Admin theo góc nhìn Product.

Admin phải dễ mở rộng.

UX phải thống nhất.

Workflow phải rõ ràng.

====================================

Hãy thiết kế lần lượt từng Domain.

KHÔNG làm tất cả cùng lúc.

Mỗi lần chỉ hoàn thành MỘT Domain.

====================================

Blueprint của mỗi Domain phải bao gồm đầy đủ:

1. Business Purpose

* Module này tồn tại để làm gì?

* Giá trị mang lại cho Admin.

---

2. Main Pages

Ví dụ:

Overview

List

Detail

Analytics

History

Settings

---

3. User Journey

Admin sẽ thao tác theo trình tự nào?

Ví dụ:

Dashboard

↓

Tutor List

↓

Tutor Detail

↓

Approve

↓

Audit

↓

Back Dashboard

---

4. Navigation

Sidebar

Breadcrumb

Tabs

Drawer

Modal

---

5. Dashboard KPI

Module này cần KPI nào?

Card nào?

Chart nào?

Summary nào?

---

6. Filters

Search

Status

Date

Category

Advanced Filters

Saved Views

---

7. Table Design

Columns

Sorting

Pagination

Selection

Bulk Action

---

8. Detail View

Không chuyển trang nếu không cần.

Ưu tiên Drawer.

Drawer gồm:

Overview

Timeline

Activity

Statistics

Related Data

Actions

---

9. Actions

Create

Edit

Archive

Hide

Approve

Reject

Suspend

Restore

Delete

Export

Import

Bulk Actions

---

10. Workflow

Lifecycle

Status

State Transition

Business Rules

---

11. Permissions

Ai được xem?

Ai được sửa?

Ai được xóa?

Ai được export?

---

12. Empty State

13. Loading State

14. Error State

15. Success State

---

16. Notifications

Module này tạo Notification nào?

---

17. Audit

Module này lưu Audit gì?

---

18. AI Opportunities

AI có thể hỗ trợ gì trong module này?

---

19. Shared Components

Những component có thể tái sử dụng.

---

20. UX Notes

Các nguyên tắc UX cần tuân thủ.

====================================

Quan trọng:

KHÔNG được chuyển sang Domain tiếp theo.

Chỉ hoàn thành MỘT Domain.

Sau khi tôi duyệt mới tiếp tục.

Không có sub-pages.\n\nTrang này chia thành các vùng theo chiều dọc:\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  ZONE A — Header: greeting + date + quick actions     │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│  ZONE B — Alert Banner (chỉ hiện khi có SLA breach    │\n│           hoặc Critical alert)                        │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│  ZONE C — KPI Cards Row 1 (Platform Health)           │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│  ZONE D — KPI Cards Row 2 (Operations Status)         │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│  ZONE E — Charts (left: Booking Volume | right: GMV)  │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│  ZONE F — Two columns:                                │\n│    Left:  Recent Activity Feed                        │\n│    Right: Operations Center mini-queue (top 5)        │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│  ZONE G — Platform Snapshot Row                       │\n│           (Tutors | Students | Services | Bookings)   │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3.  │\n│ [số thực]        │ │ [số thực]        │ │ [số thực]        │ │ [số thực]        │\n│ ↑ +12% vs. hôm  │ │ ↑ +8% vs. 7d avg │ │ SLA cao nhất:    │ │ CRITICAL: [n]    │\n│ qua              │ │
