|\n\n**Compatibility Notes:**\n- Layers 1 and 2 have known conflicts (GAP-003, GAP-004). Actual table state depends on production execution order.\n- Layer 13 runs on every server.js startup (`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` — idempotent). It cannot retroactively fix conflicts from earlier layers.\n- No rollback scripts exist for any layer.\n- No `schema_migrations` table exists to record which layers have been applied or when.\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 2 — ENTITY-RELATIONSHIP OVERVIEW\n\n### 2.1 Core Entity Map\n\n```\nIDENTITY DOMAIN\n  users (central hub — all domains reference this table)\n    ├── tutor_profiles        (1:1, tutor role only)\n    ├── tutor_certificates    (1:N, tutor role only)\n    ├── wallets               (1:1, all roles — created by trigger)\n    ├── login_logs            (1:N, audit)\n    └── is_banned             (direct column on users)\n\nCOMMUNICATION DOMAIN\n  messages        (N:N via sender_id / receiver_id → users)\n  notifications   (N:1 → users)\n\nPARENTAL DOMAIN\n  parent_children      (N:N → users: parent_id + student_id)\n  student_link_codes   (1:1 CHAR(8) code per student)\n\nCLASS WORKSPACE DOMAIN\n  classes               (tutor_id → users)\n    ├── class_members   (N:N → users)\n    ├── materials*      (class_id FK)\n    ├── assignments*    (class_id FK)\n    ├── lessons*        (class_id FK)\n    ├── discussions     → discussion_replies\n    └── learning_paths  → learning_path_steps\n  * subject to GAP-004 conflict\n\nCOURSE MODULE DOMAIN\n  courses            (tutor_id FK — canonical server.js version)\n  course_lessons     (course_id FK)\n  course_enrollments (user_id + course_id FK)\n  course_progress    (enrollment_id + lesson_id FK — v2 canonical)\n\nASSESSMENT DOMAIN\n  quizzes → quiz_questions → quiz_attempts\n  exam_papers → exam_paper_questions → exam_paper_attempts\n  practice_sessions (standalone)\n\nMATCHING & INTERACTION DOMAIN\n  tutor_requests          (30+ columns, 14-step wizard, student_id nullable)\n  student_tutor_interactions\n  tutor_sessions          (booking records)\n  tutor_reviews\n  lesson_feedbacks        (RLS enabled, FK constraints absent — GAP-007)\n  reviews                 (reviewer_id only, missing tutor_id — GAP-009)\n\nFINANCE DOMAIN\n  wallets        (balance + held_balance, co-owned with Identity)\n  transactions   (PostgreSQL ENUM types — GAP-005)\n  disputes       (1:1 → transactions)\n  invoices       (invoice_no UNIQUE)\n  coupons\n  wishlists      (user_id + course_id)\n```\n\n### 2.2 Central Entity: users\n\nThe `users` table is the database's hub. Every domain has at least one FK to `users`. `transactions.wallet_id`\n- `tutor_requests.student_id`, `tutor_requests.match_status`\n- `messages.sender_id`, `messages.receiver_id`\n- `class_members.class_id`, `class_members.user_id`\n\nThese are observations. Actual query patterns in production determine whether indexes are warranted.\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 8 — CONSTRAINTS & ENUM TYPES\n\n### 8.1 CHECK Constraints by Table\n\n| Table | Column | Allowed Values |\n|-------|--------|---------------|\n| users | role | 'student', 'parent', 'tutor', 'admin' |\n| tutor_profiles | status | 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected' |\n| tutor_requests | match_status | 'pending', 'matching', 'matched', 'closed' |\n| lesson_feedbacks | focus_rating | 1–5 (SMALLINT range) |\n| lesson_feedbacks | understanding_level | 'Tốt', 'Khá', 'Cần cố gắng' |\n| lesson_feedbacks | homework_status | 'Đã hoàn thành', 'Chưa hoàn thành', 'Không có bài tập' |\n\n### 8.2 PostgreSQL ENUM Types\n\nDefined in `payment_migration.sql` as database-level type objects:\n\n```\ntransaction_type:   DEPOSIT | WITHDRAW | PAYMENT | REFUND | COMMISSION\ntransaction_status: PENDING | SUCCESS | FAILED | HELD_IN_ESCROW | RELEASED | REFUNDED | DISPUTED\n```\n\nPostgreSQL ENUMs require `ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE` to extend. This cannot be rolled back. See GAP-005.\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 9 — SOFT DELETE & DATA LIFECYCLE\n\n### 9.1 Deletion Strategy\n\nSoft delete is not implemented. No `deleted_at` column exists on any table (see GAP-002).\n\nCurrent archival patterns in use:\n- `users`: `is_banned = TRUE` (record retained, access blocked)\n- `tutor_profiles`: `status = 'rejected'` (effective archival)\n- `tutor_requests`: `match_status = 'closed'`\n- Financial records: permanent retention (implicit audit requirement)\n\n### 9.2 Data Retention Gaps\n\n- `login_logs`: no TTL or cleanup mechanism documented\n- Assessment seed data embedded in migration files — not separable from schema\n- No cascade delete strategy documented for full user account deletion\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 10 — PERFORMANCE CONSIDERATIONS\n\n### 10.1 High-Volume Tables\n\n| Table | Expected Growth | Notes |\n|-------|----------------|-------|\n| transactions | High — every payment event | No partitioning strategy |\n| login_logs | High — every auth event | No TTL / cleanup mechanism |\n| messages | High — all direct messages | No archival strategy |\n| notifications | Medium-high | No read-cleanup mechanism |\n\n### 10.2 Stored Function Performance\n\nThe 4 escrow stored functions execute within single transactions. They handle atomic balance operations. No performance issues documented at current scale. Under high concurrency, `hold_money_for_lesson` may create row-level lock contention on `wallets`.\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 11 — SECURITY & ACCESS CONTROL\n\n### 11.1 Row Level Security (RLS)\n\nOnly `lesson_feedbacks` has RLS enabled via Supabase. All other tables rely on application-layer access control: JWT verification + role-check middleware in server.js.\n\n### 11.2 Sensitive Columns\n\n| Table | Column | Protection |\n|-------|--------|-----------|\n| users | password_hash | Bcrypt-hashed — never returned in API responses |\n| wallets | balance, held_balance | Application-layer permission check |\n| transactions | amount | Application-layer permission check |\n| messages | content | No encryption at rest documented |\n\n---\n\n## SECTION 12 — SPECIFICATION GAPS\n\nGaps represent divergences between the current database schema and Technical Specification v1.0 (EPIC 0.8), or internal consistency issues. Each gap is preserved exactly from v1.0. The **Future Direction** blocks in this version replace the SQL-based recommendations from v1.0 with architecture-level guidance.\n\n**Severity Classification:**\n- **P0** — Blocks a dependent Epic; must be resolved before that Epic begins\n- **P1** — Does not block current work but creates technical debt or consistency risk\n- **P2** — Minor inconsistency; can be deferred without material impact\n\n---\n\n### GAP-001 — Status Value Casing Convention\n\n**Severity:** P1\n**Affects:** All tables with status columns\n\n**Current Database State:**\nAll status CHECK constraints use lowercase values: `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `matching`, `matched`, `closed`.\n\n**Technical Specification v1.0 Mandate:**\nSection 4 specifies SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for status/ENUM values: `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`.\n\n**Impact:**\nAPI responses return lowercase values. If the frontend or middleware normalizes to SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, comparison logic breaks across the stack. Inconsistency between spec and database creates onboarding confusion and subtle query bugs.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P1 — resolve before Sprint 3):**\nArchitectural concern: the status casing convention must be locked before any new status-dependent feature is built. Two paths exist: (a) amend Technical Specification v1.1 to formally accept lowercase as canonical — the simpler path since the database already uses it uniformly — or (b) define a normalization layer at the API response boundary that maps lowercase DB values to SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE API values. The chosen path must be documented in a Technical Specification update and applied consistently across all domains. Mixing conventions across tables or API endpoints is not acceptable. This decision belongs in the Tech Lead's Epic 0 review.\n\n---\n\n### GAP-002 — No Soft Delete Support\n\n**Severity:** P1\n**Affects:** All tables\n\n**Current Database State:**\nNo `deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ` column exists on any table. Archival is status-based only.\n\n**Technical Specification v1.0 Mandate:**\nSection 4 recommends `deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ` for recoverable deletion.\n\n**Impact:**\nHard deletes are permanent with no recovery path. No audit trail for record removal. Cascade deletes on FK relationships can silently orphan related records in tables without FK constraints.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P1 — architectural decision before Epic 1):**\nArchitectural concern: soft delete should not be applied uniformly to all tables without domain-level analysis. For the EduX business model, financial records (transactions, invoices, disputes) must never be deleted under any circumstance. Tutor profiles and user accounts benefit from soft delete for account recovery and compliance. Class content (lessons, assignments) may warrant soft delete for accidental-deletion recovery. The soft delete strategy must be defined per domain in a Technical Specification amendment before Epic 1 begins. The implementation scope should be narrow: Identity domain and Finance domain first. Assessment, Messaging, and Communication domains can defer. This document does not prescribe the column definition or migration approach — that is an Epic 1 implementation decision.\n\n---\n\n### GAP-003 — courses Table: instructor_name TEXT vs tutor_id UUID FK\n\n**Severity:** P0\n**Affects:** courses table, Course Module domain, Tutor Center Epic, Finance domain\n\n**Current Database State:**\n`backend/schemas/course_detail_schema.sql` (Layer 2) defines `courses` with `instructor_name TEXT NOT NULL` and no FK to users.\n`backend/server.js` auto-migrate (Layer 13) defines `courses` with `tutor_id UUID REFERENCES users(id)` and no instructor_name.\nDue to `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, the first definition to execute wins. If Layer 2 ran before Layer 13, production has `courses` with `instructor_name TEXT` and no `tutor_id`. If the server.js version ran first (e.g., in a fresh environment), the reverse is true. Both columns may co-exist if an undocumented ALTER was applied manually.\n\n**Impact:**\nAll course-tutor JOIN queries are broken without a proper `tutor_id` FK. The Tutor Center Epic cannot surface a tutor's courses. Finance queries for tutor revenue from courses are unbuildable without this relationship.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P0 — resolve before Tutor Center and Course Module Epics start):**\nArchitectural decision: `tutor_id UUID FK → users(id)` is the canonical relationship. `instructor_name TEXT` is a denormalized convenience field that may be retained for display fallback but cannot serve as the structural relationship anchor between courses and tutors. The production database state must be verified by the Tech Lead: confirm whether `tutor_id` exists on the courses table in production. If it does not, the data reconciliation approach — ensuring every course row has a valid `tutor_id` populated — must be defined as part of Epic 0 P0 fixes. The approach to get there (data backfill strategy, verification criteria, rollback plan) is an implementation decision outside the scope of this document.\n\n---\n\n### GAP-004 — Schema Conflict: lessons / assignments / materials Defined Twice\n\n**Severity:** P0\n**Affects:** lessons, assignments, materials tables; Class Workspace domain; Course Module domain\n\n**Current Database State:**\n`backend/schema.sql` (Layer 1) defines `lessons`, `assignments`, and `materials` with `class_id FK → classes(id)`.\n`backend/schemas/course_detail_schema.sql` (Layer 2) redefines the same 3 tables with `course_id FK → courses(id)`.\nDue to `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, Layer 2's definitions are silently skipped if Layer 1 ran first (the expected production case). The actual FK columns on these tables in production depend entirely on execution order.\n\n**Impact:**\nIf Layer 1 won (likely): `lessons`, `assignments`, `materials` are class-based. Any Course Module query expecting a `course_id` column on these tables will fail. The `course_detail_schema.sql` versions have effectively never existed in production.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P0 — confirm production state before any content feature development):**\nArchitectural decision: the two naming conventions serve different and non-overlapping purposes. They should not be conflated:\n1. **Class-based content** (Layer 1, canonical): `lessons(class_id)`, `assignments(class_id)`, `materials(class_id)` — these are Class Workspace Domain tables and should remain as-is.\n2. **Course-based content** (Layer 13, canonical): `course_lessons(course_id)` — this is the Course Module Domain's content table, already correctly defined in server.js auto-migrate.\n\n`course_detail_schema.sql` should be treated as a deprecated and superseded file. Its `lessons/assignments/materials` definitions with `course_id` are not needed because `course_lessons` in server.js serves that purpose. The Tech Lead must confirm this interpretation against actual production state before any Course Module or Class Workspace feature work begins. No SQL action is prescribed by this document.\n\n---\n\n### GAP-005 — transactions Table Uses PostgreSQL ENUM Types\n\n**Severity:** P1\n**Affects:** transactions table, Finance domain\n\n**Current Database State:**\n`transaction_type` and `transaction_status` are PostgreSQL ENUM type objects defined at the database level, not TEXT + CHECK constraints.\n\n**Technical Specification v1.0 Preference:**\nTEXT + CHECK constraints are preferred for operational flexibility.\n\n**Impact:**\nAdding a new transaction type or status value requires `ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE` in PostgreSQL. This operation cannot be executed inside a transaction block in older PostgreSQL versions, cannot be easily rolled back, and requires careful coordination in production.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P1 — confirm value completeness before Finance Epic begins):**\nArchitectural concern: the current ENUM value sets may not cover all Finance domain transaction flows. Before the Finance Center Epic begins, the Tech Lead must audit whether the current values (`DEPOSIT`, `WITHDRAW`, `PAYMENT`, `REFUND`, `COMMISSION` / `PENDING`, `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, `HELD_IN_ESCROW`, `RELEASED`, `REFUNDED`, `DISPUTED`) cover all planned business scenarios (e.g., `CHARGEBACK`, `PARTIAL_REFUND`, `COMMISSION_REVERSAL`). If any values are anticipated to be added, the type strategy must be reconsidered at the start of the Finance Epic — not mid-sprint when it creates deployment risk. If the current values are sufficient, no action is required and this remains a P2 observation.\n\n---\n\n### GAP-006 — wallets Table Missing created_at Column\n\n**Severity:** P2\n**Affects:** wallets table\n\n**Current Database State:**\n`wallets` has `updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ` but no `created_at` column. The `create_wallet_for_new_user` trigger fires on user creation, so wallet creation time is effectively equivalent to user creation time.\n\n**Technical Specification v1.0 Mandate:**\nSection 4 requires `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()` on all tables.\n\n**Impact:**\nCannot directly determine when a wallet was created from the wallets table. Minor audit gap — derivable via JOIN to users.created_at.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P2 — opportunistic, no Epic dependency):**\nArchitectural note: `created_at` on wallets is semantically equivalent to `users.created_at` for the same user ID, since wallets are always created by trigger at the moment of user registration. Adding `created_at` to wallets is a non-breaking additive change with no data migration complexity — the column can be back-populated from `users.created_at` via a JOIN. This can be addressed as a housekeeping task within any Epic that touches the Finance domain, without blocking any other feature.\n\n---\n\n### GAP-007 — lesson_feedbacks Missing FK Constraints\n\n**Severity:** P1\n**Affects:** lesson_feedbacks table, data integrity for the Booking domain\n\n**Current Database State:**\n`lesson_feedbacks.lesson_id`, `.tutor_id`, and `.student_id` are declared `UUID NOT NULL` but carry no FK constraints to any other table. The RLS policies correctly reference `tutor_id` and `student_id` for access control, but there is no referential integrity enforcement at the database level.\n\n**Impact:**\nOrphaned feedback records can exist if the referenced user or lesson is deleted. The `lesson_id` column has no clear target table (lessons table is class-based; no bookings table yet exists). JOIN queries to reconstruct a lesson's feedback history require application-layer assumptions about what `lesson_id` references.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P1 — resolve as part of Booking Center domain definition):**\nArchitectural concern: the `lesson_id` FK cannot be correctly defined until the Booking Center domain table is established. The question \"what does `lesson_id` reference?\" has three possible answers: `lessons(id)` (class-based session), `tutor_sessions(id)` (current booking record), or a future canonical `bookings(id)` table. This ambiguity must be resolved when the Booking Center domain is designed. At that point, `lesson_feedbacks.lesson_id` should be migrated to reference the canonical booking entity. The `tutor_id` and `student_id` FKs to `users(id)` are unambiguous and can be addressed earlier — their addition is a non-breaking constraint on existing NOT NULL UUID columns. This is an Epic 5 (Booking Center) concern for `lesson_id`, and an Epic 2 (Tutor Center) housekeeping item for `tutor_id` and `student_id`.\n\n---\n\n### GAP-008 — Amount Precision: NUMERIC(15,2) vs NUMERIC(15,0)\n\n**Severity:** P2\n**Affects:** wallets, transactions, tutor_requests (budget_min, budget_max)\n\n**Current Database State:**\nAll monetary columns use `NUMERIC(15,2)` — supports two decimal places (e.g., 150,000.50 VND).\n\n**Technical Specification v1.0:**\nSection 4 specifies `NUMERIC(15,0)` — integer-only (no decimal sub-units).\n\n**Impact:**\nIn the Vietnamese market, VND does not use decimal sub-units in practice. `NUMERIC(15,2)` is technically more flexible but inconsistent with the spec. Display formatting at the application layer must account for potential `.00` values.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P2 — correct the spec, not the database):**\nArchitectural recommendation: the Technical Specification v1.0 should be updated to reflect `NUMERIC(15,2)` as the canonical precision. Per the Source of Truth Hierarchy in this document (Section 1.4), the production database definition takes precedence over the specification when they conflict without a deliberate reason to change. There is no business reason to reduce decimal precision on monetary columns — doing so would be a breaking change with no benefit. Application-layer formatting should render VND amounts as integers (strip the `.00`) regardless of storage precision. This is a spec correction action, not a database action.\n\n---\n\n### GAP-009 — reviews Table Missing tutor_id FK\n\n**Severity:** P0\n**Affects:** reviews table, Tutor Center rating display, AI Matching Algorithm\n\n**Current Database State:**\nThe `reviews` table (Layer 13, server.js auto-migrate) has `reviewer_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`. No `tutor_id` column exists. There is no way to JOIN the reviews table to a specific tutor from the database side.\n\n**Observed Production Consequence (P0-1 bug):**\n`POST /api/tutors/matches` hardcodes `0 AS rating, 0 AS review_count` in the SELECT clause because the reviews table cannot be queried by tutor. Every tutor in AI matching results displays 0 stars and 0 reviews.\n\n**Secondary concern:**\n`reviewer_id ON DELETE SET NULL` destroys the audit trail when a reviewer's account is deleted. A review rating should survive reviewer deletion — only the reviewer identity should be anonymized.\n\n**Future Direction (Priority: P0 — must resolve before Tutor Center Epic begins):**\nArchitectural concern: the `reviews` table is currently non-functional for EduX's core tutor reputation use case. Two structural changes are required at the architecture level:\n\n1. **Tutor relationship:** A `tutor_id UUID FK → users(id)` column must be added to reviews, linking each review to the tutor being reviewed. This is the primary key relationship that enables all rating queries, profile displays, and matching score calculations.\n\n2. **Reviewer deletion policy:** `ON DELETE SET NULL` on `reviewer_id` destroys audit trail. The correct behavior is either (a) retain the review record with `reviewer_id` nullified (current behavior — acceptable for anonymization) but ensure the rating value is preserved, or (b) use soft delete at the application layer. The data model choice must be confirmed by the Tech Lead.\n\nThe implementation approach for establishing `tutor_id` on existing `reviews` rows (if any exist) is an Epic 0 P0 fixes decision. Until this gap is closed, all tutor rating display in matching, search, profile, and analytics features is non-functional and must be treated as a known broken state.\n\n---\n\n## STATUS\n\n```\nEPIC 0.9 — Database Schema & Data Architecture Specification\nVersion:    1.1 (LOCKED)\nStatus:     Production-Grade Specification — Descriptive, not prescriptive\nMigration layers documented: 13\nTables documented: 40+\nSpecification gaps identified: 9 (P0: 3, P1: 4, P2: 2)\nP0 gaps must be resolved in Epic 0 before any domain Epic can begin work\non their affected tables\n```"

'Xem CCCD' : 'Chưa tải lên CCCD'}\n946\t          >\n947\t            <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]\">badge</span>\n948\t            Xem CCCD\n949\t          </button>\n950\t </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </ModalOverlay>\n      )}\n\n      {/* ══ IMAGE PREVIEW MODAL ══ */}\n      {(previewLoading || previewUrl || previewError) && (\n         <button\n              className=\"absolute top-2 right-2 z-10 bg-black/50 text-white p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-black/70 transition-colors\"\n              onClick={() => {         "new_string": "// ── GET /api/admin/users ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Returns all users with optional search and role filter. Supports pagination.\n// Query params: search, role, page (default 1), limit (default 20)\napp.get(\"/api/admin/users\", verifyToken, requireAdmin, async (req, res) => {\n  const { search = \"\", role = \"all\", page = \"1\", limit = \"20\" } = req.query;\n  const offset = (parseInt(page) - 1) * parseInt(limit);\n\n  const conditions = [];\n  const values = [];\n  let idx = 1;\n\n  if (search.trim()) {\n    conditions.push(`(u.full_name ILIKE $${idx} OR u.email ILIKE $${idx})`);\n    values.push(`%${search.trim()}%`);\n    idx++;\n  }\n  if (role !== \"all\") {\n    conditions.push(`u.role = $${idx}`);\n    values.push(role);\n    idx++;\n  }\n\n  const where = conditions.length ? `WHERE ${conditions.join(\" AND \")}` : \"\";\n\n  try {\n    const countResult = await pool.query(\n      `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u ${where}`,\n      values\n    );\n    const total = parseInt(countResult.rows[0].count);\n\n    const result = await pool.query(\n      `SELECT u.id, u.full_name, u.email, u.role, u.picture,\n              COALESCE(u.is_banned, false) AS is_banned, u.created_at\n       FROM users u\n       ${where}\n       ORDER BY u.created_at DESC\n       LIMIT $${idx} OFFSET $${idx + 1}`,\n      [...values, parseInt(limit), offset]\n    );\n\n    return res.json({ users: result.rows, total, page: parseInt(page), limit: parseInt(limit) });\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/admin/users error:\", err);\n    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n  }\n});\n\n// ── PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/ban ───────────────────────────────────────────\n// Bans or unbans a user. Cannot ban admin accounts.\n// Body: { \"banned\": true | false }\napp.patch(\"/api/admin/users/:id/ban\", verifyToken, requireAdmin, async (req, res) => {\n  const { id } = req.params;\n  const { banned } = req.body;\n\n  if (typeof banned !== \"boolean\") {\n    return res.status(400).json({ message: \"'banned' must be a boolean.\" });\n  }\n\n  try {\n    // Prevent banning admin accounts\n    const check = await pool.query(\"SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = $1\", [id]);\n    if (!check.rows.length) return res.status(404).json({ message: \"User not found.\" });\n    if (check.rows[0].role === \"admin\") {\n      return res.status(403).json({ message: \"Cannot ban an admin account.\" });\n    }\n\n    const result = await pool.query(\n      `UPDATE users SET is_banned = $1 WHERE id = $2\n       RETURNING id, full_name, email, role, is_banned, created_at`,\n      [banned, id]\n    );\n    return res.json(result.rows[0]);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/ban error:\", err);\n    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n  }\n});\n\n// ── PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/role ──────────────────────────────────────────\n// Changes a user's role. Cannot change admin accounts.\n// Body: { \"role\": \"student\" | \"tutor\" | \"parent\" }\napp.patch(\"/api/admin/users/:id/role\", verifyToken, requireAdmin, async (req, res) => {\n  const { id } = req.params;\n  const { role } = req.body;\n  const allowed = [\"student\", \"tutor\", \"parent\"];\n\n  if (!allowed.includes(role)) {\n    return res.status(400).json({ message: `role must be one of: ${allowed.join(\", \")}` });\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const check = await pool.query(\"SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = $1\", [id]);\n    if (!check.rows.length) return res.status(404).json({ message: \"User not found.\" });\n    if (check.rows[0].role === \"admin\") {\n      return res.status(403).json({ message: \"Cannot change role of an admin account.\" });\n    }\n\n    const result = await pool.query(\n      `UPDATE users SET role = $1 WHERE id = $2\n       RETURNING id, full_name, email, role, is_banned, created_at`,\n      [role, id]\n    );\n    return res.json(result.rows[0]);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/role error:\", err);\n    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n  }\n});\n\n// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n//  QUIZ APIs\n// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"

'bg-primary text-white' : 'bg-gray-100 text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-gray-200'}`}>\n              {label}\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Table */}\n        {loading ? (\n          <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 py-16 text-error\">\n            <span className=\"material-symbols-outlined text-5xl\">error_outline</span>\n            <p className=\"text-sm\">{error}</p>\n            <button onClick={() => fetchUsers(page)} className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-primary text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold\">Retry</button>\n          </div>\n        ) : users.length === 0 ? Includes tutor_profiles data if role = tutor.\napp.get(\"/api/admin/users/:id\", verifyToken, requireAdmin, async (req, res) => {\n  const { id } = req.params;\n  try {\n    const userResult = await pool.query(\n      `SELECT id, full_name, email, role, picture,\n              COALESCE(is_banned, false) AS is_banned, created_at\n       FROM users WHERE id = $1`,\n      [id]\n    );\n    if (!userResult.rows.length) return res.status(404).json({ message: \"User not found.\" });\n\n    const user = userResult.rows[0];\n\n    // Attach tutor profile if applicable\n    if (user.role === \"tutor\") {\n      const tpResult = await pool.query(\n        `SELECT bio, subjects, experience_years, hourly_rate,\n                certificate_url, cccd_url, status AS approval_status,\n                reject_reason, profile_photo_url, phone, city, country\n         FROM tutor_profiles WHERE user_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,\n        [id]\n      );\n      user.tutor_profile = tpResult.rows[0] || null;\n    }\n\n    // Count quiz attempts for students\n    if (user.role === \"student\") {\n      const attemptsResult = await pool.query(\n        `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempts WHERE student_id = $1`,\n        [id]\n      );\n      user.quiz_attempts = parseInt(attemptsResult.rows[0].count);\n    }\n\n    return res.json(user);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/admin/users/:id error:\", err);\n    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n  }\n});\n\n// ── PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/ban ───────────────────────────────────────────"

      "tool_use_id": "toolu_01TuWFQ1NgBUdzuqmkMZiw3K",
      "type": "tool_result",
      "content": "// ── GET /api/admin/users/:id ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Returns full profile of one user. Includes tutor_profiles data if role = tutor.\napp.get(\"/api/admin/users/:id\", verifyToken, requireAdmin, async (req, res) => {\n  const { id } = req.params;\n  try {\n    const userResult = await pool.query(\n      `SELECT id, full_name, email, role, picture,\n              COALESCE(is_banned, false) AS is_banned, created_at\n       FROM users WHERE id = $1`,\n      [id]\n    );\n    if (!userResult.rows.length) return res.status(404).json({ message: \"User not found.\" });\n\n    const user = userResult.rows[0];\n\n    // Attach tutor profile if applicable\n    if (user.role === \"tutor\") {\n      const tpResult = await pool.query(\n        `SELECT bio, subjects, experience_years, hourly_rate,\n                certificate_url, cccd_url, status AS approval_status,\n                reject_reason, profile_photo_url, phone, city, country\n         FROM tutor_profiles WHERE user_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,\n        [id]\n      );\n      user.tutor_profile = tpResult.rows[0] || null;\n    }\n\n    // Count quiz attempts for students\n    if (user.role === \"student\") {\n      const attemptsResult = await pool.query(\n        `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempts WHERE student_id = $1`,\n        [id]\n      );\n      user.quiz_attempts = parseInt(attemptsResult.rows[0].count);\n    }\n\n    return res.json(user);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/admin/users/:id error:\", err);\n    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n  }\n});\n\n// ── PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/ban ───────────────────────────────────────────",
      "is_error": false
    }
  ]
}

Cannot ban admin accounts.\n// Body: { \"banned\": true | false }\napp.patch(\"/api/admin/users/:id/ban\", verifyToken, requireAdmin, async (req, res) => {\n  const { id } = req.params;",
      "is_error": false
    }
  ]
}

        "new_string": "// ── GET /api/admin/users/:id ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Returns full profile of one user. Includes tutor_profiles data if role = tutor.\napp.get(\"/api/admin/users/:id\", verifyToken, requireAdmin, async (req, res) => {\n  const { id } = req.params;\n  try {\n    const userResult = await pool.query(\n      `SELECT id, full_name, email, role, picture,\n              COALESCE(is_banned, false) AS is_banned, created_at\n       FROM users WHERE id = $1`,\n      [id]\n    );\n    if (!userResult.rows.length) return res.status(404).json({ message: \"User not found.\" });\n\n    const user = userResult.rows[0];\n\n    if (user.role === \"tutor\") {\n      const tpResult = await pool.query(\n        `SELECT bio, subjects, experience_years, hourly_rate,\n                certificate_url, cccd_url, status AS approval_status,\n                reject_reason, profile_photo_url, phone, city, country\n         FROM tutor_profiles WHERE user_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,\n        [id]\n      );\n      user.tutor_profile = tpResult.rows[0] || null;\n    }\n\n    if (user.role === \"student\") {\n      const attemptsResult = await pool.query(\n        `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempts WHERE student_id = $1`,\n        [id]\n      );\n      user.quiz_attempts = parseInt(attemptsResult.rows[0].count);\n    }\n\n    return res.json(user);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/admin/users/:id error:\", err);\n    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n  }\n});\n\n// ── PATCH /api/admin/users/:id/ban ───────────────────────────────────────────\n// Bans or unbans a user. Cannot ban admin accounts."

        "new_string": "// ── GET /api/tutors/:id ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trả về hồ sơ chi tiết của một gia sư theo user ID (public, không cần auth)\napp.get(\"/api/tutors/:id\", async (req, res) => {\n  const { id } = req.params;\n  try {\n    const result = await pool.query(\n      `SELECT\n         u.id, u.full_name, u.picture, u.email,\n         tp.bio, tp.subjects, tp.experience_years,\n         tp.hourly_rate, tp.profile_photo_url, tp.city, tp.country,\n         tp.education, tp.language, tp.teaching_style, tp.qualifications,\n         tp.first_name, tp.last_name, tp.display_name, tp.phone,\n         tp.headline,\n         COALESCE(\n           (SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating)::numeric, 1) FROM reviews r WHERE r.reviewer_id = u.id),\n           0\n         ) AS avg_r,\n         COALESCE(\n           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r WHERE r.reviewer_id = u.id),\n           0\n         ) AS review_count\n       FROM tutor_profiles tp\n       JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id\n       WHERE u.id = $1 AND tp.status = 'approved'\n       LIMIT 1`,\n      [id]\n    );\n    if (result.rows.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ message: \"Tutor not found.\" });\n    }\n    return res.json(result.rows[0]);\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/tutors/:id error:\", err.message);\n    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n  }\n});\n\n// ── GET /api/reviews/featured ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trả về các đánh giá 5 sao mới nhất để hiển thị trên trang chủ (không cần auth)"

 description TEXT,\n78\t  tutor_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n79\t  meet_link   TEXT,                          -- Google Meet link\n80\t  start_date  DATE,\n81\t  end_date    DATE,\n82\t  status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n83\t              CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'draft')),\n84\t  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n85\t  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n86\t);\n87\t\n88\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_classes_tutor_id ON classes(tutor_id);\n89\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_classes_status   ON classes(status);\n90\t\n91\tCREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_classes_updated_at\n92\tBEFORE UPDATE ON classes\n93\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n94\t\n95\t\n96\t-- ── Bảng class_members ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n97\t-- Quan hệ N-N giữa classes và students\n98\t-- Mỗi student chỉ join 1 lần vào mỗi class (UNIQUE constraint)\n99\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_members (\n100\t  id         UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n101\t  class_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n102\t  student_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)   ON DELETE CASCADE,\n103\t  joined_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n104\t\n105\t  UNIQUE(class_id, student_id)\n106\t);\n107\t\n108\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_class_members_class_id   ON class_members(class_id);\n109\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_class_members_student_id ON class_members(student_id);\n110\t\n111\t\n112\t-- ── Bảng materials ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n113\t-- Tài liệu học tập: PDF, PPT, DOCX, Video, Links\n114\t-- file_url sẽ trỏ tới Supabase Storage khi tích hợp upload\n115\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS materials (\n116\t  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n117\t  class_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n118\t  title       TEXT NOT NULL,\n119\t  description TEXT,\n120\t  file_url    TEXT,                           -- Link file trên Supabase Storage\n121\t  file_type   TEXT,                           -- VD: 'pdf', 'ppt', 'docx', 'video', 'link'\n122\t  file_size   TEXT,                           -- VD: '2.4 MB'\n123\t  uploaded_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n124\t  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n125\t  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n126\t);\n127\t\n128\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_materials_class_id    ON materials(class_id);\n129\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_materials_uploaded_by ON materials(uploaded_by);\n130\t\n131\tCREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_materials_updated_at\n132\tBEFORE UPDATE ON materials\n133\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n134\t\n135\t\n136\t-- ── Bảng assignments ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n137\t-- Bài tập do tutor giao cho lớp\n138\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignments (\n139\t  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n140\t  class_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n141\t  title       TEXT NOT NULL,\n142\t  description TEXT,\n143\t  due_date    DATE,\n144\t  created_by  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n145\t  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n146\t  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n147\t);\n148\t\n149\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_class_id   ON assignments(class_id);\n150\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_due_date   ON assignments(due_date);\n151\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_created_by ON assignments(created_by);\n152\t\n153\tCREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_assignments_updated_at\n154\tBEFORE UPDATE ON assignments\n155\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n156\t\n157\t\n158\t-- ── Bảng discussions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n159\t-- Bài đăng thảo luận trong lớp: câu hỏi, thông báo, thảo luận chung\n160\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discussions (\n161\t  id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n162\t  class_id        UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n163\t  user_id         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)   ON DELETE CASCADE,\n164\t  title           TEXT NOT NULL,\n165\t  content         TEXT,\n166\t  discussion_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'discussion'\n167\t                  CHECK (discussion_type IN ('question', 'announcement', 'discussion')),\n168\t  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n169\t  updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n170\t);\n171\t\n172\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_discussions_class_id ON discussions(class_id);\n173\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_discussions_user_id  ON discussions(user_id);\n174\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_discussions_type     ON discussions(discussion_type);\n175\t\n176\tCREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER set_discussions_updated_at\n177\tBEFORE UPDATE ON discussions\n178\tFOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();\n179\t\n180\t\n181\t-- ── Bảng discussion_replies ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n182\t-- Phản hồi cho mỗi bài thảo luận\n183\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discussion_replies (\n184\t  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n185\t  discussion_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES discussions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n186\t  user_id       UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)       ON DELETE CASCADE,\n187\t  content       TEXT NOT NULL,\n188\t  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n189\t  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n190\t);\n191\t\n192\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_replies_discussion_id ON || \"\";\n398\tconst SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY || \"\";\n399\t\n400\tasync function uploadFileToStorage(file, path) {\n401\t  if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY) Return the path within the bucket\n416\t}\n417\t\n418\tasync function createSignedUrl(path) {\n419\t  if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY) return null;\n420\t  const url = expiresIn: 3600 }), // 1 hour\n429\t  });\n430\t  const data = await response.json();\n431\t  console.log(`[Storage] Supabase sign response:`, JSON.stringify(data));\n432\t  if (!response.ok) throw \"/object/sign/tutor-documents/...\" (missing /storage/v1)\n436\t  //   2. \"/storage/v1/object/sign/tutor-documents/...\"\n437\t  // We need a full absolute URL for the frontend.\n438\t  const rawSigned = data.signedURL || data.signedUrl || (data.data && data.data.signedUrl) || null;\n439\t  if (!rawSigned) return null;\n440\t  // Already a full absolute URL ΓÇö return as-is\n441\t  if (rawSigned.startsWith('http://') || rawSigned.startsWith('https://')) {\n442\t    return rawSigned;\n443\t  }\n444\t  // Supabase returned \"/object/sign/...\" ΓÇö prepend base + /storage/v1\n445\t  if (rawSigned.startsWith('/object/')) {\n446\t    return `${SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1${rawSigned}`;\n447\t  }\n448\t  // Already has /storage/v1 prefix or other format ΓÇö just prepend base URL\n449\t Please try again.\" });\n555\t  }\n556\t});\n557\t\n558\t// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ POST /api/auth/forgot-password/request-otp ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n559\tapp.post(\"/api/auth/forgot-password/request-otp\", async (req, res) => {\n560\t  try {\n561\t    const { email } = req.body || {};\n562\t    if (!email) {\n563\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"Email is required.\" });\n564\t    }\n565\t\n566\t    const result = await pool.query(\"SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email = $1\", [email.toLowerCase().trim()]);\n567\t    if (result.rows.length === 0) {\n568\t      // Don't reveal if email exists or not, just return success\n569\t      return res.json({ message: \"Nß║┐u email tß╗ôn tß║íi, OTP ─æ├ú ─æ╞░ß╗úc gß╗¡i.\" });\n570\t    }\n571\t\n572\t    // Generate 6-digit OTP\n573\t    const otp = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();\n574\t    const expiry = new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000); // 10 minutes\n575\t\n576\t    await pool.query(\n577\t      \"UPDATE users SET reset_otp = $1, reset_otp_expiry = $2 WHERE email = $3\",\n578\t      [otp, expiry, result.rows[0].email]\n579\t    );\n580\t\n581\t    // Send email without blocking\n582\t    sendPasswordResetEmail(result.rows[0].email, otp).catch(console.error);\n583\t\n584\t    return res.json({ message: \"OTP ─æ├ú ─æ╞░ß╗úc gß╗¡i ─æß║┐n email cß╗ºa bß║ín.\" });\n585\t  } catch (error) {\n586\t    console.error(\"Request OTP error:\", error);\n587\t    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n588\t  }\n589\t});\n590\t\n591\t// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ POST /api/auth/forgot-password/reset ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n592\tapp.post(\"/api/auth/forgot-password/reset\", async (req, res) => {\n593\t  try {\n594\t    const { email, otp, newPassword } = req.body || {};\n595\t    if (!email || !otp || !newPassword) {\n596\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"Thiß║┐u th├┤ng tin y├¬u cß║ºu.\" });\n597\t    }\n598\t\n599\t    if (newPassword.length < 8) {\n600\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"Mß║¡t khß║⌐u phß║úi d├ái ├¡t nhß║Ñt 8 k├╜ tß╗▒.\" });\n601\t    }\n602\t\n603\t    const result = await pool.query(\n604\t      \"SELECT id, reset_otp, reset_otp_expiry FROM users WHERE email = $1\",\n605\t      [email.toLowerCase().trim()]\n606\t    );\n607\t\n608\t    if (result.rows.length === 0) {\n609\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"OTP kh├┤ng hß╗úp lß╗ç hoß║╖c ─æ├ú hß║┐t hß║ín.\" });\n610\t    }\n611\t\n612\t    const user = result.rows[0];\n613\t\n614\t    if (!user.reset_otp || user.reset_otp !== otp.trim()) {\n615\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"M├ú OTP kh├┤ng ch├¡nh x├íc.\" });\n616\t    }\n617\t\n618\t    if (new Date() > new Date(user.reset_otp_expiry)) {\n619\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"M├ú OTP ─æ├ú hß║┐t hß║ín. Vui l├▓ng y├¬u cß║ºu lß║íi.\" });\n620\t    }\n621\t\n622\t    // OTP hß╗úp lß╗ç, tiß║┐n h├ánh ─æß╗òi mß║¡t khß║⌐u\n623\t    const saltRounds = 12;\n624\t    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, saltRounds);\n625\t\n626\t    await pool.query(\n627\t      \"UPDATE users SET password_hash = $1, reset_otp = NULL, reset_otp_expiry = NULL WHERE id = $2\",\n628\t      [passwordHash, user.id]\n629\t    );\n630\t\n631\t    return res.json({ message: \"─Éß║╖t lß║íi mß║¡t khß║⌐u th├ánh c├┤ng!\" });\n632\t  } catch (error) {\n633\t    console.error(\"Reset password error:\", error);\n634\t    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error.\" });\n635\t  }\n636\t});\n637\t\n638\t// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ POST /api/auth/login ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n639\t// ─É─âng nhß║¡p bß║▒ng email + password\n640\tapp.post(\"/api/auth/login\", async (req, res) => {\n641\t  try {\n642\t    const { email, password } = req.body || {};\n643\t\n644\t    if (!email || !password) {\n645\t      return res\n646\t        .status(400)\n647\t        .json({ message: \"Email and password are required.\" });\n648\t    }\n649\t\n650\t    // T├¼m user theo email\n651\t    const result = await pool.query(\n652\t      \"SELECT id, full_name, email, password_hash, role, picture FROM users WHERE email = $1\",\n653\t      [email.toLowerCase().trim()]\n654\t    );\n655\t\n656\t    if (result.rows.length === 0) {\n657\t      return res\n658\t        .status(401)\n659\t        .json({ message: \"Invalid email or password.\" });\n660\t    }\n661\t\n662\t    const user = result.rows[0];\n663\t\n664\t    // User ─æ─âng k├╜ bß║▒ng Google, kh├┤ng c├│ password\n665\t    if (!user.password_hash) {\n666\t      return res.status(401).json({\n667\t        message: \"This account uses Google sign-in. Please use Google to log in.\",\n668\t      });\n669\t    }\n670\t\n671\t    // Kiß╗âm tra password\n672\t    const isMatch = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password_hash);\n673\t    if (!isMatch) {\n674\t      return res.status(401).json({ message: \"Invalid email or password.\" });\n675\t    }\n676\t\n677\t    const token = createToken(user);\n678\t\n679\t    const ip = getClientIP(req);\n680\t    const suspicious = await logLoginAttempt(user.id, ip, req.headers['user-agent']);\n681\t\n682\t    return res.json({\n683\t      token,\n684\t      user: {\n685\t        id: user.id,\n686\t        name: user.full_name,\n687\t        email: user.email,\n688\t        role: user.role,\n689\t        picture: user.picture,\n690\t      },\n691\t      suspiciousLogin: suspicious,\n692\t      loginIP: ip,\n693\t    });\n694\t  } catch (error) {\n695\t    console.error(\"Login error:\", error);\n696\t    return res.status(500).json({ message: \"Server error. Please try again.\" });\n697\t  }\n698\t});\n699\t\n700\t// ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ POST /api/auth/google Google OAuth ΓÇö l╞░u v├áo DB\n702\tapp.post(\"/api/auth/google\", async (req, res) => {\n703\t  try {\n704\t    const { credential } = req.body || {};\n705\t\n706\t    if (!googleClientId) {\n707\t      return res\n708\t        .status(500)\n709\t        .json({ message: \"GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is not configured on the server.\" });\n710\t    }\n711\t    if (!credential) {\n712\t      return res.status(400).json({ message: \"Missing Google credential.\" });\n713\t    }\n714\t\n715\t    // Verify Google token\n716\t    const ticket = await googleClient.verifyIdToken({\n717\t      idToken: return <SignUp onSwitchToSignIn={() => navigateTo('signin')} onGoHome={() => navigateTo('home')} />\n566\t  }\n567\t\n568\t  // ── Route: Admin Dashboard ──\n569\t  if (routeName === 'admin') {\n570\t
